# France Statutory Report Specifications - all 15 workbooks

Every delivered France report specification in full: the Report Matrix, Payroll Scope Summary, the complete 21-column field specification (1,428 field rows across the set), File Structure, Field Options code lists, Population Rules, Example Analysis and Sample File - for each of the 15 filings and returns.

This pass was explicitly handed off by 07-qa-crosscheck/FR-ALIGNMENT-PATCH.md, which recorded that it aligned the Data Dictionary only and left these two rows untouched. Landed in: this workbook's 'Version Control' sheet, the two named REMARKS cells, and this changelog row. No field identifier, label, position, length, format, example, option code or System Mapping cell was altered by this pass in this workbook. | Issued | Wallisson Gomes |
|  | REMARKS |  |  |  |  |
|  | Topic | Remark |  |  |  |
|  | Source of truth | Every field identifier, French label, structural path, length, data type, regular expression, code list and control rule in this workbook is read from the official published norm, not derived. Primary source: the DSN cahier technique (norme NEODeS) version CT2026.1.2, 382 pages, dated 24 December 2025, together with its machine-readable companion dsn-tableau-des-usages-CT2026.1.xlsx (Version P26V01, Revision 20251224, release 2026.1.0.9), both published by GIP-MDS on net-entreprises.fr and held in FR-compliance/00-official-sources/pdfs/. Where a value could NOT be sourced it is marked as such in place rather than inferred. |  |  |  |
|  | Downstream alignment | Data Dictionary: FR-DD-001 v1.1 - DELIVERED AND ALIGNED. This specification has been reconciled field by field against the delivered Data Dictionary (FR-compliance/07-qa-crosscheck/FR-ALIGNMENT-PATCH.md, 27 August 2026). Column L (System Mapping) no longer carries provisional identifiers: each entry is either CONFIRMED against a named FR-DD-001 sheet and row, or marked reconciled with the reason the field has no Data Dictionary counterpart. Option codes were compared code by code: 285 shared code-pairs matched exactly on both value and French local name, and the codes the Data Dictionary filters out of the regime general perimeter are now marked OUT OF SCOPE and coloured on the Field Options sheet. |  |  |  |
|  | Wage types | Wage Type Catalogue: FR-WTC-001 v1.0 - DELIVERED, at FR-compliance/02-wtc/FR-WTC-001-v1.0.xlsx (6 sheets: Version Control, Wage Type Catalogue, Sick Leave Paid By Employer, Tax Credit, Global WTC Coverage, Form Reference Guide). Its 'Form Reference Guide' sheet is the wage-type-to-filing cross-reference; it carries 47 mapping rows in total, of which 1 name FR-AGIRC-001-RetourAgircArrco-Spec.xlsx in its 'Spec File' column, each also naming the sheet and the row inside this workbook that the wage-type category lands on. Read that sheet for the wage-type direction of the mapping. Column L of this spec is the DATA DICTIONARY mapping (see the row above), not a wage-type reference: no column of this spec asserts a WTC code, so nothing here is left provisional on the catalogue. |  |  |  |
|  | SIR cross-reference | Statutory Integration Index: FR-SIR-INDEX-001 v1.0 - DELIVERED, at FR-compliance/03-statutory-integrations/FR-SIR-INDEX-001-v1.0.docx. Note the id: the France register is an authority-keyed INDEX (FR-SIR-INDEX-001), not the FR-SIR-001 register this row previously anticipated. This filing is carried in FR-compliance/scope_manifest.json as FR-AGIRC-001 and in 03-statutory-integrations/integration-landscape.json under authority NETENT-DSN (GIP-MDS / net-entreprises.fr - Declaration Sociale Nominative deposit point and returns service), which the index marks Integration = Yes over REST API (API DSN, machine-to-machine), direction(s) outbound, inbound. Its per-authority Configuration Runbook is at 03-statutory-integrations/NETENT-DSN/ - phases P1 to P7, plus INTERLINKAGES.md and effort-estimates.md. FR-AGIRC-001 plus the authority code NETENT-DSN is the stable handle; no OUT-nn identifier is asserted, because the index allocates none. |  |  |  |
|  | Scope of the build | This build is scoped to the REGIME GENERAL private-sector employer, per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt, locked before Stage 1. Public-service ([FP]) rubriques, the agricultural scheme (MSA) and the regimes speciaux are shown where the norm carries them but are marked out of scope and coloured as excluded, so that a reader can see they were considered rather than missed. |  |  |  |
|  | Language of the field names | Column B carries the AUTHORITATIVE field name - the French label exactly as the cahier technique prints it. Column A carries an English rendering for navigation; the norm publishes no English edition, so column A is a translation and column B governs. Column M leads in English and then quotes the French definition verbatim, so nothing authoritative is lost in paraphrase. |  |  |  |
|  | The columns are read in the inverted sense | This is an INBOUND flow. Column E asks whether PAYROLL MUST ACT on the value, not whether payroll populates it. Amber rows are values the engine must store and apply; blue rows are context it reads, routes and logs. The inversion is restated on the spec sheet's first section header. |  |  |  |
|  | Why this workbook specifies a field set it says you will rarely see | The spec sheet carries the full normalised NEOReS field set even though AGIRC-ARRCO uses it for one control today. Three reasons. The one control is real and is the highest-value one in the flow. The parser costs nothing extra, because FR-URSSAF-002 requires the same one. And AGIRC-ARRCO's participation can only grow - the cahier technique's stated target is that every return requiring a payroll update joins the norm. What the workbook refuses to do is present that field set as though it described how AGIRC-ARRCO anomalies reach the employer today, which is why the finding appears on the Report Matrix banner and on the spec sheet's own header rather than in a footnote. |  |  |  |
|  | What is NOT specified here, and why | The AGIRC-ARRCO online tool. It is a web interface with no published field-level layout, no XSD and no export schema, and this workbook does not invent one. A column list fabricated for it would be used to build a scraper against pages that change without notice. Where a client needs those findings in a system, the supportable route is to ask the pension group whether an export or an API exists for that client, and to record the answer in FR-SIR-001 - not to reverse-engineer the screens. |  |  |  |

## Sheet: `Report Matrix`

_27 rows x 10 columns._

**RETOUR AGIRC-ARRCO SUR LA DSN MENSUELLE - INBOUND**

**SCOPE FINDING, MEASURED NOT ASSERTED: this filing is IN SCOPE and the obligation is real - AGIRC-ARRCO checks every monthly DSN and reports back. But of the 93 AGIRC-ARRCO controls catalogued in the authority's own referential (v30/06/2026), only ONE is delivered as a machine-readable normalised return. 74 are delivered by the online tool only, 15 are never shown to the declarant, 2 carry no delivery mode and 1 is addressed to the fund's own case handlers. A build that plans to consume this flow as data the way it consumes FR-URSSAF-002 will find one control's worth of data and 92 controls' worth of web pages. See the File Structure sheet.**

| Document ID | FR-AGIRC-001 | col3 | col4 | col5 | col6 | col7 | col8 | col9 | col10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Document Title | AGIRC-ARRCO return on the monthly DSN  /  Retour AGIRC-ARRCO sur la DSN mensuelle |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Country | France (FR) - filing year 2026, currency EUR |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Authority | The AGIRC-ARRCO institutions, through the pension group to which the employer's institution belongs. Note that the employer's counterparty is its GROUP, not the federation: the membership referential that most of these controls test against is held per group. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Report Type | INBOUND return. Specified in the inverted sense - see the spec sheet's first section header. For 92 of 93 controls it is not a return in the file sense at all. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Tax Type | Not a tax. Supplementary pension contributions, compulsory for every private-sector employee, on two bands of pay. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| Relationship | Answers FR-DSN-001, whose S21.G00.78 assessable bases and S21.G00.53 activity periods most of these controls test. Distinct from FR-URSSAF-002, which is a genuinely machine-consumable normalised flow - the contrast between the two is the point of this workbook. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

## Sheet: `Payroll Scope Summary`

_28 rows x 3 columns._

**Retour AGIRC-ARRCO sur la DSN mensuelle - inbound — PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY**

**What AGIRC-ARRCO checks in the monthly DSN, and - the question that decides what a payroll build can do about it - how those findings actually reach the employer. The obligation is real and monthly. The DELIVERY is not what the scope manifest's 'via la DSN' suggests: measured from the authority's own control referential, one control of ninety-three arrives as a file. The rest are web pages, or are never shown to the employer at all.**

| ITEM / SCENARIO | IN SCOPE? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|
| ═══ WHAT AGIRC-ARRCO CHECKS ═══ |  |  |
| The capped and uncapped assessable bases | YES | 28 of the 93 controls are in the assessable-base family - by far the largest. They test the S21.G00.78 amounts against what AGIRC-ARRCO computes for the exercise, and against sign and cumulative rules. |
| Divergences between contributions declared and contributions due | YES | 17 controls across two families. These are the ones that end in a call for payment, so they are the ones a client notices. |
| The employment contract and the employee category | YES | 8 controls. The category derived from the declared data must be one the employer's membership agreement actually provides contribution terms for - which is a test against the membership referential, not against the declaration alone. |
| Working-time quotity and calendar days | YES | 5 and 3 controls respectively. The calendar-day counting used for the social security ceiling is the single most common source of a capped-base divergence. |
| Completeness of the year's deposits | YES | One control checks that every month since the start of the exercise has produced a compliant monthly DSN. It fires on a missing month, not on a bad one. |
| Partial activity and the general reduction | YES | 4 and 2 controls. Both interact with the capped base. |
| The withholding rate, or anything fiscal | NO | AGIRC-ARRCO is a social body. Nothing in this flow touches income tax. |
| ═══ HOW IT REACHES THE EMPLOYER - THE FINDING ═══ |  |  |
| As a normalised, machine-readable return | PARTIAL | For ONE control of 93: CTLAA216, the capped-base divergence. It is delivered as a normalised CRM and in the online tool. That single control is what the spec sheet specifies. |
| Through the AGIRC-ARRCO online tool only | YES | 74 controls of 93. HTML screens in the declarant space. No file, no API, no push. Somebody has to log in. |
| Not at all, to the declarant | YES | 15 controls are recorded as 'Non restitue au declarant mais sert a la construction du diagnostic visible dans l'outil d'accompagnement' - they feed a diagnostic rather than being reported - and one more is an anomaly addressed to the fund's own case handlers and expressly invisible to the declarant. The employer cannot act on these because it cannot see them. |
| As a push notification to the payroll system | NO | Nothing is pushed. Even the one normalised return has to be collected from the DSN dashboard. |
| ═══ WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE BUILD ═══ |  |  |
| Automate the consumption of AGIRC-ARRCO anomalies | NO | Not achievable today beyond the single normalised control. The integration work that FR-URSSAF-002 justifies does not pay back here, and planning it on the assumption that AGIRC-ARRCO behaves like URSSAF is the specific error this workbook exists to prevent. |
| Build the parser for the normalised return anyway | YES | The one control is real, it is the highest-value one - the capped base is where the money is - and AGIRC-ARRCO's participation in the norm can only grow. A parser built for FR-URSSAF-002 handles it with no extra work, because it is the same NEOReS format. |
| Staff a monthly manual review | YES | For 92 of 93 controls this is the only control that exists. It is an operational commitment the client must be told about explicitly at scoping, because it is recurring manual effort that no amount of payroll configuration removes. |
| Treat unseen anomalies as absent | NO | 16 controls are never shown to the declarant. They still affect the fund's view of the employer's data and can surface later as a contribution call. Their existence should be recorded in the client's risk picture even though nothing can be done about them month to month. |
| ═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══ |  |  |
| A client whose payroll is run through the TESE simplified service | YES | One control tests the coherence between the DSN's source and the management arrangement recorded for the establishment in the membership referential. A client that switches to or from a simplified service without the referential being updated generates this anomaly every month. |
| An employee whose category is not provided for in the membership agreement | YES | The category derived from the declared data is tested against the employer's own AGIRC-ARRCO membership. This is the anomaly that most often turns out to be a MEMBERSHIP problem rather than a payroll one - the fix is with the pension group, not in the payroll. |
| A missing month in the exercise | YES | Detected by the completeness control. Note that it looks at the whole exercise to date, so a gap left in February surfaces every month for the rest of the year. |
| An employee of the agricultural scheme | NO | Out of scope for this build - descoped as FR-MSA-001. One AGIRC-ARRCO control nonetheless tests for an agricultural-scheme source, which is how a mis-routed declaration is caught. |

```text
2026, held in 00-official-sources/pdfs/) which records, control by
control, the body that runs it and HOW THE RESULT REACHES THE
DECLARANT. Counting the 93 rows whose executing body is
AGIRC ARRCO gives:

74   Outil en ligne uniquement
online tool only - no file of any kind

15   Non restitue au declarant mais sert a la construction du
diagnostic visible dans l'outil d'accompagnement
never shown to the declarant at all

2   no delivery mode recorded, only a J+5 timing

1   Anomalie a destination de la gestion.
Invisible pour le declarant.

1   CRM normalise et outil en ligne
control CTLAA216 - the ONLY machine-readable return
---
93

Compare FR-URSSAF-002, measured the same way from the same file:
of 145 URSSAF controls, 123 arrive as a normalised CRM. Two bodies,
one norm, one declaration - and completely different automation
prospects.

The counts are reproducible from the referential. The authority's
own reading notes state that the cataloguing work REMAINS IN
PROGRESS, so this is a dated snapshot: re-measure when the
referential is refreshed rather than trusting these figures
indefinitely.

═══ WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE BUILD ═══
DO build the parser for the normalised return.
It is the same NEOReS format as FR-URSSAF-002, arrives on the
same dashboard, and is handled by the same code with no extra
work. Route on the issuing body in RO.B002.R005 / .R006.
CTLAA216 is also the highest-value control there is: the
capped base is where the contribution money is.

DO NOT plan an AGIRC-ARRCO anomaly integration.
There is one control's worth of data. The integration effort
that FR-URSSAF-002 justifies does not pay back here.

DO staff a monthly manual review, and name the person.
For 92 of 93 controls the online tool is the only control
that exists. An unstaffed login is an unmonitored control.
Most anomalies are available at J+5, thirteen at H+4, so the
review can be scheduled into the close rather than left
reactive.

DO tell the client at SCOPING, not at go-live.
This is recurring manual effort that no amount of payroll
configuration removes. A client that learns about it at
go-live has not resourced it.

DO record that 16 controls are invisible.
They still shape the fund's view of the employer's data and
can surface later as a contribution call. The flow must not
be recorded as fully monitored.

═══ FILE FORMAT - FOR THE ONE NORMALISED RETURN ═══
Norm            : NEOReS 2026.1.0, published 8 April 2025 by
GIP-MDS. RO.R001 carries the norm version and so
identifies the XSD and CRM-Val version to use.
Physical form   : XML, validated against the published XSD.
Forbidden chars : '<', '>' and '&' inside rubrique values.
Names           : transmitted with UNDERSCORES, not the dots the
cahier technique prints. RO.B004.R003 is
documented; RO_B004_R003 is what arrives. A
parser written from the documentation matches
nothing in a real file.
Attachment      : one transmission, one attachment flow, one DSN,
one declared establishment.
Routing         : RO.B002.R005 (name) and RO.B002.R006 (14-char
identifier) carry the issuing body. Match on the
IDENTIFIER - the name is free text up to 80
characters and is not a stable key.

For the other 92 controls there is no file format to state,
because there is no file. This workbook does not specify the
online tool's screens: it is a web interface with no published
field-level layout, and inventing a column list for it would
invite a scraper.

═══ WHAT AGIRC-ARRCO ACTUALLY CHECKS - THE 93 CONTROLS BY FAMILY ═══
28   Base assujettie                assessable base
14   Motif: ecart de cotisations    contribution divergence
8   Contrat de travail             employment contract
5   Quotite                        working-time quotity
5   Reduction                      reductions
4   Activite partielle             partial activity
4   Exoneration                    exemptions
4   Coherence referentiel AA adhesion
3   Ecart de cotisations
3   Cotisation, contribution due par l'entreprise
3   Coherence referentiel AA entreprise
2   Contrat d'adhesion
2   Reduction generale
2   Jours calendaires (+1 'jours calendaire')
1   Completude des depots
1   APEC
1   Numero de contrat
1   Somme post contrat
1   paiement

Two observations that shape the reconciliation work:

The assessable-base family is the largest by a wide margin, and
it interacts with the calendar-day families. AGIRC-ARRCO
recomputes the capped base from the CALENDAR DAYS of the
employment period taken into account for the social security
ceiling, so a base divergence is usually a day-counting
difference. Compare day counts before comparing euros.

Seven controls (the three 'coherence referentiel' families and
the two membership-contract ones) test the declaration against
the AGIRC-ARRCO MEMBERSHIP REFERENTIAL rather than against the
norm. A payroll that is internally correct can fail these, and
the fix is with the pension group, not in the payroll.
```

A parser built for that flow reads this one with no additional work, including the dot-to-underscore conversion on transmission. There is therefore no reason not to consume it, and it is the highest-value AGIRC-ARRCO control there is. | Do not build a SEPARATE AGIRC-ARRCO integration for it. Route on the issuing body in RO.B002.R005 and RO.B002.R006 within the one return-consumption process. |
| Staff the online tool, monthly, and name the person | 92 controls of 93 | The AGIRC-ARRCO declarant space | For every control except CTLAA216 the online tool is the ONLY route by which an anomaly reaches the client. That makes a monthly login part of the payroll close, not an optional check: an unstaffed login is an unmonitored control. The referential records the timing as J+5 for most controls and H+4 for thirteen, so the anomalies are available within days of the deposit and the review can be scheduled rather than reactive. | This is recurring manual effort that no payroll configuration removes, and it must be surfaced in the client's operating model at scoping. A client told at go-live that somebody has to log in every month will not have resourced it. |
| Fix the cause in payroll, not the symptom in the declaration | The assessable-base and calendar-day families | Payroll configuration | 28 assessable-base controls and 3 calendar-day controls dominate this flow, and they interact: AGIRC-ARRCO recomputes the capped base from the CALENDAR DAYS of the employment period taken into account for the social security ceiling. A divergence is therefore usually a day-counting difference rather than an amount error. Correcting the amount for one month leaves the counting wrong and the anomaly returns. | This is why the reconciliation has to be against the day count as well as the amount. Ask, for a diverging employee, how many calendar days each side used before asking why the euros differ. |
| ═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| The membership referential is a second source of truth | The contract-of-membership and category families | The client's AGIRC-ARRCO pension group | Several controls test the declaration not against the norm but against the AGIRC-ARRCO MEMBERSHIP REFERENTIAL - whether the employee category derived from the declared data has contribution terms provided for it in the employer's own membership, and whether the DSN's source is coherent with the management arrangement recorded for the establishment. A payroll that is internally correct can fail these. | The fix for a membership anomaly is with the pension group, not in the payroll. Teams that treat every anomaly as a payroll defect spend months trying to configure their way out of a membership record that is simply out of date. |
| Sixteen controls are invisible and cannot be actioned | 15 diagnostic-only controls plus 1 addressed to case handlers | n/a | The referential records these expressly: fifteen are 'Non restitue au declarant' and feed a diagnostic visible only in the supporting tool, and one is 'Anomalie a destination de la gestion. Invisible pour le declarant'. The employer cannot see them and therefore cannot act on them. | They still shape the fund's view of the employer's data and can surface later as a contribution call or a case-handler enquiry. Record their existence in the client's risk picture; do not record the flow as fully monitored. |
| Annual cumulative controls fire late | The controls timed 'J+5 en cumul annuel' | Payroll | Two controls run on the annual cumulative position rather than the month. They cannot fire until enough of the year has been declared, so a defect introduced in January may not surface until well into the year - and by then it is in every month since. | This is an argument for reconciling the AGIRC-ARRCO bases at year-end as an explicit task rather than relying on monthly anomalies to have caught everything, and it belongs in the client's year-end calendar alongside the tasks in FR-CCG-001 Module 10. |
| ═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| There is no format to specify for 92 of 93 controls | The online tool | n/a | The AGIRC-ARRCO online tool is a web interface. It has screens, not records; it has no published field-level layout, no XSD and no export schema. This workbook therefore does NOT specify it, and says so rather than inventing a column list that would be used to build a scraper against a page that changes. | If a client needs the online-tool findings in a system, the supportable route is to ask the pension group whether an export or an API exists for that client, not to scrape. | For the one normalised return, the NEOReS rules apply unchanged | The spec sheet field set | Filing component | XML, validated against the published XSD, with block and rubrique names transmitted with UNDERSCORES rather than the dots the cahier technique prints, and with '<', '>' and '&' forbidden inside values. Identical to FR-URSSAF-002 because it is the same norm. | The underscore conversion is the detail most likely to break a parser written from the documentation. It is stated in section 2.2 of the NEOReS cahier technique and is easy to miss. |
| ═══ PAYROLL-SPECIFIC POPULATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Reconcile the capped base at source | S21.G00.78 and S21.G00.53 | Payroll | Control CTLAA216 compares the sum of the capped assessable base amounts declared for the exercise of the principal declared month against the amount AGIRC-ARRCO computes, and AGIRC-ARRCO uses the calendar days of the employment period taken into account for the social security ceiling. To reconcile, extract for the employee concerned: the declared capped base by month, the calendar days declared in S21.G00.53, and the ceiling proration the payroll applied. The divergence is normally in the days. | Mid-month joiners and leavers, and employees with several concurrent contracts, are where the two day counts diverge. Test those cases explicitly rather than waiting for the anomaly. |
| Route by issuing body, not by format | RO.B002.R005 and RO.B002.R006 | Filing component | Because the one AGIRC-ARRCO normalised return arrives in the same NEOReS format and on the same dashboard as the URSSAF returns, the consumption process must route on the ISSUING BODY carried in the context block - not assume that everything NEOReS is URSSAF. An AGIRC-ARRCO capped-base anomaly routed to whoever handles URSSAF contribution-code anomalies will sit in the wrong queue. | The issuing body is carried both as a name and as a 14-character identifier. Match on the identifier; the name is free text up to 80 characters and is not a stable key. |
| Keep the manual review evidenced | The online-tool review | Client process | Because 92 of 93 controls leave no artifact in any system, the only evidence that the review happened is whatever the reviewer records. Agree with the client what is captured - date, establishments checked, anomalies found, action taken - and where it is kept. Without it, neither the client nor Mercans can demonstrate the control operated. | This matters at audit and at contract renewal. 'We check it every month' is not evidence; a dated log naming the establishments checked is. |
| ═══ CROSS-FIELD VALIDATIONS ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Bidirectional constraint | RO.B007.R002 (value declared) <-> RO.B007.R003 (value recommended) | Payroll | For the one normalised control the pair is the whole content: what the employer declared for the capped base against what AGIRC-ARRCO computed. Neither means anything alone. Each names the other in its Conditional Reason. | The recommended value is AGIRC-ARRCO's assertion of what the base should be, not a correction already applied. Reconcile before adopting it, because adopting it without understanding the day count hides the cause. |
| Bidirectional constraint | RO.B000.R004 (declared SIRET) <-> the membership referential | The client's AGIRC-ARRCO pension group | Several controls compare the establishment identified in the return against what the membership referential holds for it - the management arrangement, the contribution terms available for each employee category. The declaration and the referential are two sources of truth and both must be maintained. | A new establishment that has been added to payroll but not to the membership referential generates anomalies from its first month and cannot be fixed in payroll at all. |

## Sheet: `Sample File`

_35 rows x 1 columns._

```text
Retour AGIRC-ARRCO sur la DSN mensuelle - inbound — SAMPLE FILE
OMITTED, and for two distinct reasons that should not be conflated. FIRST: for the 92 controls delivered through the online tool there is no file to sample - they are HTML screens with no published field layout, no XSD and no export schema, and fabricating a 'sample' of a web page would be worse than useless. SECOND: for the one normalised control the format is NEOReS XML with a published XSD, and the same rule applies here as in FR-URSSAF-002 - a fabricated XML instance for a flow that HAS an official schema will be used to build a parser and will encode guesses about element nesting as though they were the schema. No official specimen exists in FR-compliance/00-official-sources/sample-files/. The verified structural facts are on the File Structure sheet, and the Example Analysis sheet parses individual values in the transmitted underscore form with every invented value marked ILLUSTRATIVE.

SAMPLE FILE DELIBERATELY NOT PROVIDED - FOR TWO DIFFERENT REASONS.

REASON 1 - for 92 of the 93 controls, THERE IS NO FILE.

They are delivered as screens in the AGIRC-ARRCO online tool. A web
interface has no record layout, no XSD and no published export
schema. There is nothing to sample, and a fabricated 'example' of a
web page would invite somebody to build a scraper against a page
that changes without notice.

REASON 2 - for the one normalised control, CTLAA216, the format is
NEOReS XML and an OFFICIAL XSD exists.

The rule that applies in FR-URSSAF-002 applies here for the same
reason: a fabricated XML instance would be used to build a parser
and would encode this workbook's guesses about element nesting as
though they were the schema.

What IS verified, and is on the File Structure sheet:

- the one normalised return is XML, validated against the published
XSD with the CRM-Val validator;
- its block and rubrique names arrive with UNDERSCORES, not dots
(RO_B004_R003, not RO.B004.R003);
- it arrives on the same DSN dashboard as the URSSAF returns and is
distinguished by the issuing body in RO.B002.R005 / .R006;
- the delivery-mode split across all 93 controls, measured from the
authority's referential.

To obtain a real instance: retrieve a CRM from a live client's DSN
dashboard on net-entreprises.fr where a CTLAA216 anomaly has fired,
or request the XSD and CRM-Val validator from GIP-MDS.
```

Channel: online_form / portal consultation - the notification appears as a badge in the 'Votre compte' area of the personalised menu and is opened from 'Vos notifications' \| Portal: net-entreprises.fr, service 'Consulter ses taux AT/MP et prevenir ses risques professionnels' \| Source: modop-atmp.pdf, 14 January 2026 \| CONFIRMED for the channel, LAYOUT NOT OBTAINED |

## Sheet: `Payroll Scope Summary`

_29 rows x 3 columns._

**Notification dematerialisee du taux AT/MP - compte AT/MP sur net-entreprises.fr — PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY**

**Where the industrial-accident contribution rate comes from, who must be registered to receive it, and - the point where builds actually go wrong - the fact that one notification produces TWO numbers used in two different calculations. The notified rate computes the contribution. A fixed 0.49 mutualised points, not the notified rate, enters the general reduction. And the rate is per ESTABLISHMENT, changing in-year on reclassification, so it cannot be held as a company parameter.**

| ITEM / SCENARIO | IN SCOPE? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|
| ═══ WHO RECEIVES IT ═══ |  |  |
| Every employer, from the first employee | YES | Since 1 January 2022 the dematerialised notification is compulsory for ALL COMPANIES WHATEVER THEIR HEADCOUNT. There is no de minimis: an employer with one employee must be registered for the service. |
| A mono-establishment employer | YES | Registers on the SIRET concerned, accesses the service for that SIRET, and receives the notification for it. |
| A multi-establishment employer | YES | Registers ON THE HEAD-OFFICE SIRET ONLY - which the source states is sufficient to access all establishments - and then accesses and receives notifications for ALL its SIRETs. This asymmetry is worth knowing: registering each establishment separately is unnecessary work. |
| A service provider or holding company, on a client's behalf | YES | It may request authorisation for the SIRETs in its portfolio, and the source states that the client's legal obligation is then CONSIDERED FULFILLED. But note the condition: the provider must have filed at least one DSN in the LAST THREE MONTHS for the client concerned. A newly-onboarded client is therefore not immediately accessible. |
| A client who also wants to receive the notification directly | YES | The source addresses this expressly: where the client also wishes to receive the notification, it must register on net-entreprises itself and request it, following the mono-establishment case. Provider access does not automatically give the client visibility. |
| ═══ WHAT IT CARRIES ═══ |  |  |
| The establishment's net AT/MP rate | YES | The payload. Applied to the uncapped base to compute the employer's AT/MP contribution. |
| The risk number | YES | And it has a second consumer: the work-accident declaration form asks for it, and its notice states that it is the number appearing on the rate notification for the activity under which the victim's salary is accounted. |
| The establishment it applies to | YES | The rate is per establishment. This is the storage key. |
| The date from which it applies | YES | Which is not always 1 January, because notifications also arrive during the year on reclassification. |
| The elements the rate was computed from | PARTIAL | The rate is set from the establishment's activity and, above a size threshold, from its own accident history. Whether and how the calculation elements are presented on the notification was not established for this build - it is marked as such on the spec sheet rather than asserted. |
| An employee-side rate | NO | There is none. The AT/MP contribution is entirely borne by the employer. |
| The 0.49 points used in the general reduction | NO | That is a STATUTORY CONSTANT set by decree, not a notified value. It is specified on this sheet because it is the number used instead of the notified rate in the reduction, and confusing the two is the characteristic error in this area. |
| ═══ TIMING ═══ |  |  |
| Mostly at the start of the year | YES | The source: updates occur 'majoritairement chaque debut d'annee'. |
| But also during the year | YES | 'mais egalement en cours d'annee' - on reclassification of the establishment's activity. So the engine must be able to apply a mid-year rate change from its own effective date. |
| The rate can be applied from the month it is read | NO | It applies from its EFFECTIVE DATE, which may precede the date somebody logged in and saw the badge. A notification read late produces a retrospective correction, not a change from today. |
| A rate applies until the next notification | YES | Unlike the withholding rate of FR-DGFIP-002, it does not expire on its own after two months. The two inbound rates behave differently and must not be modelled with one mechanism. |
| ═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══ |  |  |
| An establishment reclassified mid-year | YES | A new notification with its own effective date. Apply from that date, not from 1 January and not from today. |
| An employee who moves between establishments mid-year | YES | Contributed for at two different rates, one for each period. This is the case that a company-level rate parameter cannot represent at all. |
| A new establishment with no accident history | YES | Rated on its activity rather than on experience, below the size threshold at which experience rating applies. It still receives a notification. |
| A client not registered for the service | YES, AND URGENTLY | It cannot lawfully receive its rate, and it is accruing a penalty of 0.5 % to 1.5 % of the monthly ceiling per employee. Because the penalty is per employee and scales with headcount, an unregistered client of any size is accumulating a material cost silently. This belongs in onboarding, not in a later review. |

## Sheet: `File Structure`

_166 rows x 1 columns._

```text
Notification dematerialisee du taux AT/MP - compte AT/MP sur net-entreprises.fr — FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

═══ THE SUBSCRIPTION - COMPULSORY, PENALISED, AND CHECKED FIRST ═══
Since 1 JANUARY 2022 the dematerialised notification of the AT/MP
rate has been COMPULSORY FOR ALL COMPANIES, WHATEVER THEIR
HEADCOUNT. To satisfy it, each company must be registered for the
service « Consulter ses taux AT/MP et prevenir ses risques
professionnels » on net-entreprises.fr.

Without the registration the employer CANNOT LAWFULLY RECEIVE ITS
OWN RATE, and attracts a penalty of between 0,5 % and 1,5 % of the
monthly social security ceiling PER EMPLOYEE - 1 % for employers of
20 to 149 employees, the maximum rate above that.

Note the shape of that penalty: per employee, per period, scaling
with headcount. It is not a nominal fine. An unregistered client is
accruing a material and recurring cost, silently.

THE REGISTRATION MATRIX, from the source's own summary table:

register on        access for      notification
----------------  -----------------  --------------  ------------
Mono-etablt       the SIRET          that SIRET      that SIRET
Multi-etablts     the HEAD-OFFICE    ALL SIRETs      ALL SIRETs
SIRET only
(suffices for all)
Tiers declarant   the CLIENT SIRET   client SIRET    client SIRET
(conditions)    (conditions)

CONDITIONS on a service provider's access: the provider must have
made at least ONE DSN IN THE LAST THREE MONTHS for the client
concerned. Two consequences:

- the authorisation cannot be obtained before the first DSN is
filed, so it is not an end-of-implementation task;
- it LAPSES if DSN filing stops for a quarter.

The source also states that where a service provider holds the
authorisation, the client's legal obligation is CONSIDERED
FULFILLED - but that if the client ALSO wishes to receive the
notification, it must register on net-entreprises itself and
request it, as a mono-establishment employer would.

═══ HOW THE NOTIFICATION ARRIVES - THERE IS NO PUSH ═══
1.  Log in at net-entreprises.fr via « Votre compte ».
2.  On the personalised menu, under « Votre compte », the
notification appears as a BADGE with a count.
3.  Under « Votre tableau de bord », click « Vos notifications »
then « Consulter ses notifications ».
4.  Click the line concerned to open the menu, then the
consultation pictogram.
5.  Optionally ARCHIVE it for later, or DELETE it.

Nothing is pushed. Nothing arrives by email. Somebody has to look.

Two operational consequences:

- Checking only in January is not enough. Updates occur
'majoritairement chaque debut d'annee mais egalement en cours
d'annee', and a mid-year rate applies from ITS OWN effective
date - so a late check converts into a correction rather than
a change from today.

- DELETING is easy and irreversible. The notification is the
only record of what rate applied from when, and it is what an
employer examines before deciding whether to contest a
determination. Agree retention with the client, and prefer
archiving.

═══ THE TWO NUMBERS - THE PART BUILDS GET WRONG ═══
One notification produces TWO numbers, used in TWO different
calculations. They are not interchangeable and they are easy to
confuse because both are percentages.

THE NOTIFIED NET RATE  ->  THE CONTRIBUTION
uncapped base x the establishment's own notified rate
= the employer's AT/MP contribution.
Varies by establishment. Varies by year. Experience-rated
above a size threshold.

A FIXED 0,49 POINTS   ->  THE GENERAL REDUCTION
The establishment's actual rate is NOT USED in the general
reduction of employer contributions. A fixed mutualised
fraction applies instead:

0,49 percentage points for 2026
(0,50 in 2025)
Social Security Code art. D241-2-4
FR-CCG-001 Module 5

Does NOT vary by establishment. Changes annually by decree.

Using the notified rate in the reduction OVER-RELIEVES an
establishment with a high accident rate and UNDER-RELIEVES one
with a low rate. Nothing rejects it: the declaration is
structurally valid either way.

SANITY CHECK at configuration: if the reduction fraction differs
between two establishments of the same client, the configuration
is using the wrong number.

SECOND SANITY CHECK: the constant MOVED for 2026. A build carried
over from 2025 is wrong even if it got the principle right.
Refreshing it belongs in the annual parameter task.

═══ THE LOOP WITH THE ACCIDENT DECLARATION ═══
This flow and FR-CPAM-002 feed each other, over a cycle of a year
or more.

this notification
|
|  supplies the RISK NUMBER that the work-accident
|  declaration form requires - its notice states
|  it is the number 'figurant sur la notification
|  du taux applicable a l'activite dans laquelle
|  est comptabilise le salaire de la victime'
v
FR-CPAM-002  accident declared, volet 2 -> CARSAT
|
|  reaches the establishment's occupational-risk
|  record
v
a FUTURE year's rate notification

Two things follow that are worth telling a client:

- accuracy in accident declarations is a FINANCIAL matter, not
only a compliance one. In particular the work-accident versus
commuting-accident characterisation bears differently on the
employer's own rate;

- a stale risk number on an accident declaration attaches the
accident to the wrong risk category, and the consequence
appears in a rate notified a year or more later - by which
time nobody connects the two.

═══ SCOPE - NOT NEOReS, AND NOT LIKE THE WITHHOLDING RATE ═══
NOT NEOReS. The NEOReS cahier technique 2026.1.0 names the AT/MP
and bonus-malus rate transmissions among the returns that COULD
join the normalisation perimeter later:

« D'autres retours pourront integrer le perimetre par la
suite, notamment les transmissions des taux ATMP et
Bonus-Malus ... »

'Pourront' settles it: they have not. There is no normalised CRM
to parse here today, and the parser built for FR-URSSAF-002 does
not apply. Re-check each norm year - if this transmission joins
NEOReS it becomes a parseable file rather than a portal
notification, which converts this filing from a manual check into
an integration.

NOT LIKE THE WITHHOLDING RATE. Three inbound rate flows exist in
this build and they behave differently:

FR-CARSAT-001    FR-DGFIP-002
granularity       ESTABLISHMENT    EMPLOYEE
lifetime          until replaced   EXPIRES after 2 months
channel           portal page      file retrieval / API
format            no layout        not obtained; XML in API
normalised        no               no (expressly excluded)

The dangerous half of confusing them is applying this flow's
'persists until replaced' behaviour to the withholding rate,
which then never expires and is silently wrong from the third
month. See FR-DGFIP-002.
```

| Check the subscription before anything else | The AT/MP account registration | Client onboarding | The dematerialised notification has been compulsory for all employers from the first employee since 1 January 2022, and the employer cannot lawfully receive its rate without being registered. Establish at onboarding: is the client registered, on which SIRET, and should Mercans hold the authorisation as service provider? The registration matrix is asymmetric - a multi-establishment employer registers on the HEAD-OFFICE SIRET ONLY, which is sufficient for all establishments - so getting it right is quicker than getting it wrong. | A service provider's access is conditional on having filed at least one DSN in the LAST THREE MONTHS for the client concerned. So the authorisation cannot be obtained before the first DSN is filed, which means it is not something to leave to the end of implementation - and a client whose DSN filing lapses for a quarter loses the provider's access to its own rates. |
| Store the rate PER SIRET, as a dated series | Taux net AT/MP with its effective date | The notification | The rate is per ESTABLISHMENT and it changes in-year on reclassification. The engine must therefore hold it as a dated series keyed on SIRET, not as a single overwritable company parameter. An employee who moves between establishments mid-year is contributed for at two different rates for the two periods, and no company-level parameter can represent that. | This is the commonest configuration error on this contribution. It does not fail on deposit - the declaration is structurally valid with any rate - so it is found either by an inspection or not at all. |
| Feed the risk number to the accident-declaration process | Numero de risque | The notification | The work-accident declaration (FR-CPAM-002) asks for the social security risk number, and its notice states that it is the one APPEARING ON THE NOTIFICATION OF THE RATE applicable to the activity under which the victim's salary is accounted. Store it with the rate, per SIRET, and make it available to whoever completes an accident declaration - which is usually HSE, not payroll. | A stale risk number on an accident declaration attaches the accident to the wrong risk category, which distorts the establishment's own experience rating. The effect is on the FUTURE rate, so it is invisible for a year or more - and it is a loop: this notification's own successor is what carries the consequence. |
| ═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Do NOT use the notified rate in the general reduction | 0.49 points against the notified rate | Payroll configuration | The establishment's actual AT/MP rate calculates the CONTRIBUTION. It is NOT used in the general reduction of employer contributions, where a fixed mutualised fraction applies instead: 0.49 percentage points for 2026 under Social Security Code art. D241-2-4, down from 0.50 in 2025 (FR-CCG-001 Module 5). One notification, two numbers, two calculations. | Using the notified rate in the reduction over-relieves an establishment with a high accident rate and under-relieves one with a low rate. The declaration remains structurally valid either way, so nothing rejects it. And because the constant CHANGED for 2026, a build carried over from 2025 is wrong even if it got the principle right - refreshing it must be a scheduled annual task. |
| Apply an in-year change from its effective date | Date d'effet du taux | Payroll engine | Notifications arrive mostly at the start of the year but also during it, on reclassification. A mid-year notification applies from ITS OWN effective date - not from 1 January, and not from the month somebody noticed the badge on the dashboard. Where the effective date precedes the discovery, the difference is corrected for the affected periods. | This is why the rate must be a dated series. An engine with a single rate field can only apply a change prospectively, which is wrong whenever the effective date is in the past - and it silently loses the history needed to explain the correction. |
| Do not model this rate like the withholding rate | This flow against FR-DGFIP-002 | Payroll engine design | Both are rates that arrive from an authority and are applied without being computed, so it is tempting to build one mechanism for both. They behave differently in three ways: this rate is per ESTABLISHMENT and that one is per EMPLOYEE; this one persists until replaced and that one EXPIRES AFTER TWO MONTHS; this one is notified on a portal and that one is retrieved as a file. | The dangerous half of the confusion is applying this flow's 'persists until replaced' behaviour to the withholding rate, which then never expires and is silently wrong from the third month. See FR-DGFIP-002. |
| This flow is not NEOReS | The notification | Filing component | The NEOReS cahier technique 2026.1.0 names the AT/MP and bonus-malus rate transmissions among the returns that COULD JOIN the normalisation perimeter later - which establishes that they have not joined it. There is no normalised CRM to parse here today, and the parser built for FR-URSSAF-002 does not apply. | Worth re-checking each norm year. If and when the AT/MP transmission joins NEOReS it becomes a parseable file rather than a portal notification, which would change this filing from a manual consultation into an integration. |
| ═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| The rate and the fraction are both percentages, and they are not interchangeable | Taux net AT/MP and the 0.49 points | Payroll | The notified net rate is a percentage applied to the uncapped base. The 0.49 is a number of PERCENTAGE POINTS entering the general-reduction coefficient. They are expressed similarly and used in completely different formulae, which is exactly why they are confused. | A useful sanity check at configuration: the notified rate varies by establishment and by year; the 0.49 does not vary by establishment at all. If a configuration has the reduction fraction differing between two establishments of the same client, it is using the wrong number. |
| The notification's own formats | The spec sheet rows | n/a | NOT SPECIFIED, because the notification is consulted on the portal and no field-level layout was obtained. Column J says so rather than carrying a guess. | What IS exact is the USE of the values, which is what this workbook specifies instead. |
| ═══ PAYROLL-SPECIFIC POPULATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Somebody must look at the dashboard | The notification badge | Client process, or Mercans as service provider | The notification is signalled by a badge in the 'Votre compte' area of the personalised menu on net-entreprises.fr and is opened from 'Vos notifications'. Nothing is pushed, and nothing arrives by email. Because notifications also appear during the year, checking only in January is not enough - and because the rate applies from its effective date rather than from when it was read, a late check converts into a correction. | Notifications can be ARCHIVED or DELETED from the dashboard. Agree with the client which, and who does it: a deleted notification is not recoverable evidence of what rate applied from when, and that evidence matters if the determination is later questioned. |
| The loop with the accident declaration | FR-CPAM-002 and this flow | HSE and payroll jointly | Accidents declared under FR-CPAM-002 reach the establishment's occupational-risk record through the CARSAT volet, and bear on the rate notified here in a future year. This flow in turn supplies the risk number that the accident declaration asks for. The two are a loop, and the loop closes over a year or more. | The practical consequence is that accuracy in accident declarations is a financial matter for the client and not only a compliance one - particularly the work-accident versus commuting-accident characterisation, which bears differently on the employer's own rate. Worth saying to a client that treats accident declarations as paperwork. |
| Retain the notifications | The notification documents | Client document retention | Keep each notification, per establishment, with its effective date. It is the evidence of what rate applied from when, it is what an employer examines before deciding whether to contest a determination, and it is the source of the risk number that appears on accident declarations. | The dashboard offers archive and delete. Deleting is easy and irreversible, and the notification is the only record of a determination the client may later need to contest. |
| ═══ CROSS-FIELD VALIDATIONS ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Bidirectional constraint | Taux net AT/MP <-> the 0.49 mutualised points | Payroll configuration | The two are alternatives, not a hierarchy: the notified rate is used for the CONTRIBUTION and the fixed 0.49 points for the GENERAL REDUCTION. Each row on the spec sheet names the other, because the only way to get this right is to know that both exist and which belongs where. | The tell-tale of a wrong configuration is a reduction that differs between two establishments of the same client for no reason other than their accident records. |
| Bidirectional constraint | SIRET <-> Taux net AT/MP <-> Date d'effet | Payroll engine | The three together are the storage key and value of a dated rate series: which establishment, what rate, from when. None of the three is meaningful without the others, and each names the others. | An engine storing rate without SIRET cannot handle a multi-establishment client; storing rate without effective date cannot handle a mid-year reclassification. Both failures are common and neither is detected by any validation. |
| Bidirectional constraint | Numero de risque <-> FR-CPAM-002 accident declaration | HSE and payroll | The risk number notified here is the one the accident declaration form requires, for the activity under which the victim's salary is accounted. The constraint spans two documents and two functions, which is why it is easy to leave implicit and easy to get wrong. | Where one establishment carries several activities with different risk numbers, the number to declare on an accident is the one for the activity the VICTIM's salary is booked under - not the establishment's principal activity. |

_17 rows x 4 columns._

**Notification dematerialisee du taux AT/MP - compte AT/MP sur net-entreprises.fr — EXAMPLE FILE ANALYSIS**

| Raw Value | Field Name | Interpretation | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| ═══ THE NOTIFICATION ═══ |  |  |  |
| SIRET 83912345600024 | SIRET de l'etablissement | The establishment this rate applies to. | ILLUSTRATIVE value. The storage key - a company with five establishments receives five notifications and stores five rates. |
| Taux net : 2,08 % | Taux net AT/MP | The establishment's own net contribution rate, applied to the uncapped base. | ILLUSTRATIVE value. Set from the establishment's activity and, above a size threshold, its own accident history - so it differs between establishments of the same company. |
| N° de risque : 741CE | Numero de risque | The risk category the rate was set on. | ILLUSTRATIVE value. ALSO the value the work-accident declaration asks for - FR-CPAM-002 sources it from here. |
| Date d'effet : 01/01/2026 | Date d'effet du taux | From when it applies. | Not always 1 January: notifications also arrive during the year on reclassification, and then apply from their own date. |
| ═══ THE TWO NUMBERS THAT COME OUT OF ONE NOTIFICATION ═══ |  |  |  |
| 4 100,00 x 2,08 % = 85,28 | AT/MP employer contribution | The NOTIFIED rate applied to the uncapped base. This is the only place the establishment's actual rate is used. | ILLUSTRATIVE figures. Entirely an employer contribution - there is no employee share. |
| 0,49 points (2026) | Fraction imputable sur la reduction generale | In the general reduction, the notified rate is NOT used. A fixed mutualised 0.49 percentage points applies instead, under Social Security Code art. D241-2-4. | It was 0.50 in 2025. A build carried over from last year is wrong even if it got the principle right. See FR-CCG-001 Module 5. |
| 2,08 % used in the reduction | THE CHARACTERISTIC ERROR | Using the notified rate in the general reduction over-relieves a high-rate establishment and under-relieves a low-rate one. | Nothing rejects it - the declaration is structurally valid. The tell-tale is a reduction that differs between two establishments of the same client for no reason but their accident records. |
| ═══ THE REGISTRATION MATRIX ═══ |  |  |  |
| Mono-etablissement | Register on the SIRET concerned | Access and notification for that SIRET. | Quoted from the mode d'emploi's own summary table. |
| Multi-etablissements | Register on the HEAD-OFFICE SIRET ONLY | The source states this is SUFFICIENT to access all establishments - access and notifications follow for ALL SIRETs. | Registering each establishment separately is unnecessary work. This asymmetry is worth knowing before starting. |
| Tiers declarant | Register on the CLIENT's SIRET | Access and notification for the client SIRET, PROVIDED the provider has filed at least one DSN in the LAST THREE MONTHS for that client. | The three-month condition means the authorisation cannot be obtained before the first DSN is filed - and lapses if DSN filing stops for a quarter. |
| Client who also wants the notification | Register separately, as a mono-establishment employer | Provider access does NOT automatically give the client visibility of its own notifications. | The source addresses this case expressly. Agree with the client which of you watches the dashboard. |

## Sheet: `Sample File`

_50 rows x 1 columns._

```text
Notification dematerialisee du taux AT/MP - compte AT/MP sur net-entreprises.fr — SAMPLE FILE
OMITTED - the channel is a PORTAL CONSULTATION and no field-level layout was obtained. This is a v2.7 STEP 3.5 outcome rather than a gap left open: the notification is transmitted to the employer's net-entreprises dashboard, signalled by a badge in the 'Votre compte' area, and opened from 'Vos notifications' - it is a document to be READ, not a file to be parsed. The official mode d'emploi held in 00-official-sources/pdfs/modop-atmp.pdf documents how to register for the service and how to find and open a notification; it does not document what fields the notification contains, and no other published layout was found. There may not be one. No official sample exists in FR-compliance/00-official-sources/sample-files/. What this workbook specifies instead is what the notified values ARE USED FOR, which is exact and is the part a payroll build has to get right - including the distinction between the notified rate and the fixed 0.49 mutualised points, which is where builds actually go wrong.

SAMPLE FILE DELIBERATELY NOT PROVIDED - THE CHANNEL IS A PORTAL
CONSULTATION.

VERIFIED CHANNEL (v2.7 STEP 3.5):

Channel  : online_form / portal consultation. Nothing is pushed
and nothing arrives by email.
Portal   : net-entreprises.fr, service « Consulter ses taux AT/MP
et prevenir ses risques professionnels »
How it   : a badge appears in the 'Votre compte' area of the
arrives    personalised menu. Open it from 'Votre tableau de bord'
-> 'Vos notifications' -> 'Consulter ses notifications',
then click the line and the consultation pictogram.
Notifications can be ARCHIVED or DELETED from there.
Frequency: 'majoritairement chaque debut d'annee mais egalement en
cours d'annee'.
Source   : modop-atmp.pdf, 14 January 2026, held in
00-official-sources/pdfs/.
Status   : CONFIRMED for channel and portal.
LAYOUT NOT OBTAINED - and there may be no published one.

WHY NOTHING IS INVENTED:

A fabricated file for a filing that is consulted on a web page
would invite an integration to a channel that emits no file. That
is a C25 audit failure.

WHAT IS SPECIFIED INSTEAD, AND IS THE PART THAT MATTERS:

What the notified values are USED FOR. Specifically:

- the notified NET RATE calculates the AT/MP contribution;
- a fixed 0,49 MUTUALISED POINTS - not the notified rate - is
what enters the general reduction of employer contributions
(CSS art. D241-2-4 for 2026; it was 0,50 in 2025);
- the RISK NUMBER is what the work-accident declaration
FR-CPAM-002 asks for;
- the rate is stored PER SIRET as a DATED SERIES, because
notifications also arrive mid-year on reclassification.

Those four points are where real builds go wrong. A sample file
would not have helped with any of them.

TO CLOSE THE LAYOUT GAP:
obtain a real rate notification for a French client, and confirm
with the CARSAT or GIP-MDS whether any machine-readable export
exists. If one does, this workbook should be re-versioned.
```

The definition of the platform, the May 2023 rule that no sum may be sent directly to institutions, the in-kind-grants carve-out, the net-entreprises credential requirement, the 'Mes SIRET' troubleshooting rule, the grouping mechanics with their two-SIRET minimum and one-group-per-SIRET restriction, the three allocation levels, the search keys including the UAI code, the direct percentage entry and the explicitly NON-BINDING estimated amount are all read from that guide. MEDIUM for column L pending FR-DD-001, though most of column L here correctly says the field is NOT payroll-sourced. MEDIUM FOR THE CAMPAIGN DATES, and this is the one thing to re-check before use: the guide obtained describes the 2025 campaign, whose synthesis page changed behaviour at the end of June 2025. FR-CCG-001 Module 10 records the 2026 window as 26 May to 21 October. The dates move every year and are the single most perishable fact in this workbook - confirm them on the platform each spring rather than relying on this document. LOW, AND BY NATURE: THERE IS NO RECORD LAYOUT. This is a web application with screens, not a file format, and no import or export schema was found. Column H says so on every row. This workbook does not attempt to specify the screens field by field beyond what the guide documents, because a fabricated column list would invite an automation of pages that change without notice. What would improve it: the current campaign's guide each year, and confirmation from the Caisse des Depots of whether any bulk import exists for employers with very many establishments. Channel: online_form - a web application \| Portal: SOLTeA, Caisse des Depots, entered with net-entreprises credentials \| Source: SOLTeA guide utilisateur portail employeurs, Caisse des Depots \| CONFIRMED |

## Sheet: `Payroll Scope Summary`

_27 rows x 3 columns._

**SOLTeA - repartition du solde de la taxe d'apprentissage (portail employeurs) — PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY**

**What happens to the apprenticeship-tax balance AFTER it has been declared and paid. This is not a filing: it is an optional allocation, on a portal, of money that has already left the company. Three things follow for a payroll build. It is a client business decision, not a payroll calculation. Doing nothing produces no error anywhere - a default rule simply decides where the money goes. And therefore the only thing payroll owes here is a reliable annual reminder, because nothing else will tell the client the step exists.**

| ITEM / SCENARIO | IN SCOPE? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|
| ═══ WHO USES IT ═══ |  |  |
| An employer that has paid the apprenticeship-tax balance | YES | The platform is for employers liable for the balance. Whether they use it is their choice. |
| An employer with several establishments | YES | And it can group its SIRETs so that one allocation, made with a reference SIRET, is duplicated automatically onto the rest. Minimum two SIRETs per group, and no SIRET may belong to two groups. |
| An employer that makes no allocation | YES, PASSIVELY | Nothing breaks. A default rule distributes the funds. This is the central operational fact about this filing: inaction has a consequence but produces no error, no reminder and no visible symptom. |
| An employer not liable for the balance | NO | Nothing to allocate. If a SIRET the client expects is missing from 'Mes SIRET', the guide's own troubleshooting says the likely cause is a missing net-entreprises AUTHORISATION rather than an absence of liability - contact the account administrator. |
| Payroll, on the client's behalf | NO | Not without an explicit mandate. Which institutions a company supports is a business decision about the company's relationships and priorities, and it is not payroll's to make. Payroll's responsibility is to make sure the client knows the step exists and knows the window. |
| ═══ WHAT CAN BE ALLOCATED TO ═══ |  |  |
| An establishment | YES | The whole institution. |
| A component or secondary establishment | YES | The guide describes institutions with components, revealed by expanding the institution's menu, each with its own information sheet. An employer can support one faculty or campus rather than the whole institution. |
| An eligible course | YES | Searchable by course, returning the establishments and components that deliver it, with the course title and the qualification. This is the finest level - an employer can direct funds at the specific training it wants to see delivered. |
| An institution directly, by sending it money | NO | Since MAY 2023 no sum may be sent directly to institutions by employers. SOLTeA is the single national entry point, and the guide says so in terms. |
| An apprentice training centre, by giving it equipment | PARTIAL | In-kind grants of equipment and materials to apprentice training centres remain POSSIBLE but are NOT MANAGED ON THIS PLATFORM. They are declared instead as a reduction of the balance in the April DSN, under code 077. So they happen outside SOLTeA and reduce what there is to allocate inside it. |
| ═══ WHAT IS NOT DONE HERE ═══ |  |  |
| Declaring the balance | NO | Done in the April DSN, under S21.G00.82 code 076 - FR-URSSAF-004. |
| Paying the balance | NO | Paid to URSSAF with the April DSN. By the time an employer reaches SOLTeA the money has already left. |
| Computing the balance | NO | 0.09 % of the closed preceding year's payroll, computed in payroll and declared in April. SOLTeA neither computes nor verifies it. |
| Reconciling anything against the DSN | NO | And specifically: the estimated amount an employer may enter before June is described by the guide as ESTIMATIVE, WITHOUT BINDING VALUE for the employer, and SOLTeA retains only the allocation itself. It must not be treated as a declaration or reconciled as one. |
| ═══ TIMING ═══ |  |  |
| Within the annual campaign window | YES | FR-CCG-001 Module 10 records the 2026 window as 26 May to 21 October. THE DATES MOVE EVERY YEAR. |
| After the April DSN in which the balance was declared | YES | The sequence is fixed: declare and pay in April, allocate from late May. An employer cannot allocate a balance it has not declared. |
| The window can be extended on request | NO | Not to an individual employer. It is a national campaign. |
| A missed window can be caught up next year | NO | The funds for that year are distributed by the default rule and are gone. Next year's campaign allocates next year's balance. |

## Sheet: `File Structure`

_157 rows x 1 columns._

```text
SOLTeA - repartition du solde de la taxe d'apprentissage (portail employeurs) — FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

═══ WHAT SOLTeA IS, AND WHAT IT IS NOT ═══
From the guide's own definition:

SOLTeA is an online service for employers liable for the
APPRENTICESHIP-TAX BALANCE and for the institutions entitled
to receive it. A NATIONAL PLATFORM, the single entry point for
all liable employers, allowing them to express their wishes as
to allocation towards establishments, components or secondary
establishments, or eligible courses.

and, crucially:

« Depuis mai 2023, plus aucune somme ne peut etre directement
adressee aux etablissements par les employeurs. Les
subventions en nature aux centres de formation d'apprentis
sous forme d'equipement et de materiel demeurent possibles
mais ne sont pas gerees sur la plateforme. »

So: no direct payments since May 2023; in-kind grants still
possible but handled elsewhere - as a reduction of the balance in
the April DSN under code 077 (FR-URSSAF-004).

WHAT IT IS NOT:
- not a declaration. The balance is declared in the April DSN.
- not a payment. The balance is paid to URSSAF in April.
- not compulsory. A default rule applies to any unallocated
balance.
- not a payroll decision. Which institutions to support is a
business choice.

═══ THE SEQUENCE, AND WHERE PAYROLL'S DUTY ENDS ═══
payroll        computes 0,09 % of the closed preceding year
|
FR-URSSAF-004  declares it in the APRIL DSN under
S21.G00.82 code 076, and pays URSSAF
|
<---- payroll's OBLIGATION ends here
|
late May       the SOLTeA campaign opens
|
FR-CDC-001     the employer directs where the money goes
- or does not, and a default rule decides
|
October        the campaign closes. The choice is gone.

Payroll's OBLIGATION ends in April. Its RESPONSIBILITY does not:
the client will only know the second step exists if somebody
tells them, and nothing else will.

Make it a dated item in the annual client calendar. Repeat it
every year - the window moves, and the person who knew last year
may have gone. Mention that the platform can rebuild a previous
campaign's basket, because 'this will take ten minutes' gets
acted on and 'you need to allocate your apprenticeship tax' does
not.

═══ ACCESS - THE ONLY HARD PREREQUISITE ═══
Credentials : net-entreprises - SIRET, surname, first name,
password - after the authorisation has been
ACTIVATED. The guide points a reader whose
authorisation is not active to the
net-entreprises start-up guide first.

Mes SIRET   : the liable establishments appear here.

THE GUIDE'S OWN TROUBLESHOOTING RULE: before
using the grouping feature, make sure the SIRETs
liable for the balance are visible in this tab.
IF A SIRET IS MISSING, contact the administrator
of the net-entreprises account so that they
grant the authorisation for it.

So a missing SIRET is an ACCESS problem, not a
liability problem - unless it is also missing
from the April DSN, in which case it is a
payroll problem in FR-URSSAF-004 and cannot be
fixed here at all.

Confirm the authorisation while the DSN authorisation is being
set up, not in May. Inside a campaign window, an authorisation
request competes with the deadline.

═══ GROUPING - ONE ALLOCATION FOR SEVERAL ESTABLISHMENTS ═══
An employer holding several SIRETs may form a group so that the
allocation made with ONE REFERENCE SIRET is DUPLICATED
AUTOMATICALLY onto the other SIRETs in the group.

Step 1   name the group
Step 2   add the SIRETs - in bulk with « Tout ajouter », or by
searching on SIREN, SIRET or company name
Step 3   designate the REFERENCE SIRET

TWO HARD CONSTRAINTS, both stated in the guide:

- AT LEAST TWO SIRETs must be added to a group;
- A SIRET CANNOT BELONG TO MORE THAN ONE GROUP.

Where an employer wants different policies for different parts
of the business, that must be expressed as several DISJOINT
groups, or as per-SIRET allocation for the establishments that
differ.

Choose the reference SIRET deliberately. Its allocation becomes
every other establishment's.

═══ CHOOSING RECIPIENTS - THREE LEVELS AND FIVE SEARCH KEYS ═══
LEVELS a recipient can be chosen at:

1  an ESTABLISHMENT
2  a COMPONENT or secondary establishment. An institution
with components reveals them by expanding its menu, and
each has its own information sheet - 'the university'
and one of its institutes are DIFFERENT recipients
3  an eligible COURSE. Searching by course returns the
establishments and components that deliver it, with the
course title and the qualification

SEARCH KEYS:

establishment name | CODE UAI | acronym (SIGLE) | SIRET |
town               | course

USE THE UAI CODE. It is the national identifier for an
educational establishment and it is the only stable key here.
Names are ambiguous, institutions merge and rename, and a wrong
selection sends money to somebody else with no way back once
the campaign closes.

THE ALLOCATION ITSELF is expressed in PERCENTAGES, typed
directly into the selection. Because it is proportional, an
allocation made early stays valid if the final balance differs
from what was expected - which is why the estimated-amount
field can be non-binding without causing a problem.

═══ THE ESTIMATED AMOUNT - EXPLICITLY NOT A DECLARATION ═══
Until June an employer may enter the total amount it estimates it
will have to allocate for its establishment. The guide is unusually
explicit about the status of that entry:

« NB : cette saisie est estimative. Elle n'a pas de valeur
engageante pour vous et SOLTeA ne conservera que votre
repartition ... »

Three consequences:

- it is a planning aid, not a declaration;
- SOLTeA retains only the ALLOCATION, not the estimate;
- DO NOT reconcile it against the balance declared in the April
DSN. A build that does is comparing a non-binding estimate
with a declaration and will report differences that mean
nothing.

If a reconciliation is wanted, reconcile the April DSN's code 076
against the payroll computation of 0,09 % - not against anything
in SOLTeA.
```
