## Sheet: `Payroll Scope Summary`

_47 rows x 3 columns._

**DSN Mensuelle - Monthly Nominative Social Declaration — PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY**

**Tells the developer WHO is reported in the monthly DSN and WHAT is reported about them. The DSN is not a report of totals: it disaggregates each payroll result down to the individual employee, contract, base and contribution, and then re-aggregates it into the payment due to each collecting body. Both levels must reconcile.**

| ITEM / SCENARIO | IN SCOPE? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|
| ═══ WHO GETS REPORTED ═══ |  |  |
| Full-time employees on an open-ended contract (CDI) | YES | The core population. One S21.G00.40 contract block each. |
| Part-time employees | YES | Reported identically; the part-time position is carried by the working-time unit and contractual working time (S21.G00.40.011 / .013), and by the part-time-contributing-full-time flag (S21.G00.40.045) where that option is exercised. |
| Fixed-term employees (CDD) and agency workers | YES | Reported with the reason for use (S21.G00.40.021) and, for agency work, the user establishment (S21.G00.85). |
| Apprentices and work-study contracts | YES | Reported through the public-policy scheme rubrique (S21.G00.40.008). They also drive the apprenticeship-tax and disabled-worker positions. |
| Company officers treated as employees (mandataires assimiles salaries) | YES | In payroll scope: they hold a contract block with an appropriate employment status and are subject to income tax as employees (General Tax Code art. 80 ter, FR-CCG-001 Module 11). |
| Self-employed company officers (travailleurs non salaries) | NO | Out of the employment-type scope of this build - assessed and paid personally under the SSI scheme. Recorded as FR-URSSAF-005 in scope_manifest.authority_filings.out_of_scope. The norm's S89.G00.91 to S89.G00.94 blocks that would carry them are shown on the spec sheet as excluded. |
| Freelancers and suppliers invoicing for services | NO | Not employees. Fees are an accounts-payable obligation carried by the S89.G00.32 fee-reporting vehicle, not by payroll. |
| Employees of the agricultural scheme (MSA) | NO | Separate collection network and separate deposit channel. Descoped as FR-MSA-001. |
| Public-service employees (fonction publique) | NO | Out of scope per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt. The norm's [FP] rubriques are shown on the spec sheet as excluded. |
| Employees under a regime special (RATP, ENIM, CNIEG, CRPCEN, CNBF, CAVIMAC) | NO | Out of scope per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt, which locks this build to the regime general. |
| ═══ WHAT GETS REPORTED ═══ |  |  |
| Gross salary and every element making it up | YES | One S21.G00.51 remuneration block per component type code, each carrying the period the pay is FOR - which may not be the payment month. |
| Overtime, and the exempt overtime counter | YES | Reported with its own remuneration type code. The employer flat deduction is a negative individual contribution; the annual income tax exemption cap is a year-to-date counter payroll must hold. |
| Benefits in kind | YES | Reported in the other-gross-elements blocks (S21.G00.54) and inside the bases. |
| Tax-exempt allowances and professional expenses | YES | Reported so that the exemption is evidenced rather than assumed; the specific flat-rate deduction rate is carried at contract level (S21.G00.40.023). |
| Every contribution base, separately | YES | Capped gross, uncapped gross, supplementary pension bands 1 and 2, unemployment base, social levies base - one S21.G00.78 block each, with its own attachment period. |
| Each employee and employer contribution | YES | One S21.G00.81 block per contribution code and collecting body. |
| The general reduction (RGDU) and the employer overtime deduction | YES | As NEGATIVE individual contributions under their own codes - which is why the negative-allowed flag on S21.G00.81.004 matters. |
| Net taxable amount, withholding rate, rate type and tax withheld | YES | In the individual payment block S21.G00.50. This is the whole of the employer's income tax reporting - see FR-DGFIP-001. |
| Net social amount (montant net social) | YES | A statutory quantity used by the benefits authorities. Also a compulsory payslip line, so it must be one stored value feeding both. |
| Aggregate contributions per establishment | YES | S21.G00.23, rounded to the WHOLE EURO - the individual lines are not. |
| Employer payments to each collecting body | YES | S21.G00.20, with BIC and IBAN. Collection is by direct debit initiated from this file. |
| Fees paid to self-employed service providers | NO | An accounts-payable obligation. The norm carries a fee-reporting vehicle (S89.G00.32 and following) but it is not fed from payroll, and it is shown as excluded on the spec sheet. |
| Company-vehicle taxes | NO | Assessed on the fleet, not on remuneration. Descoped as FR-FIN-001. Distinct from the company-vehicle benefit in kind, which IS in scope. |
| ═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══ |  |  |
| One file per establishment | YES | The declaration is built per SIRET. A multi-establishment client produces one declaration block per establishment. |
| A correction filed before the month's deadline | YES | Sent as declaration type '03 - annule et remplace integral', which supersedes the first filing entirely. |
| A correction filed after the month's deadline | NO | There is no cancel-and-replace after the deadline. The correction is carried in a LATER monthly DSN against the period it belongs to, using the attachment-period rubriques - never added to the current month's base. |
| An annual reconciliation filing at year end | NO | France has none. The December DSN is an ordinary monthly DSN. What the year end requires is calculations landing INSIDE that payroll - final ceiling reconciliation, annual RGDU reconciliation, closing the social-levies allowance cap and the exempt-overtime counter (FR-CCG-001 Module 10.5). |
| A nil declaration where there are no employees | YES | Sent as transmission type '02 - envoi neant' with declaration type '02 - declaration normale sans individu'. Permitted ONLY for nature 01 - an event signal cannot exist without an individual. |
| ═══ AMOUNTS, ROUNDING AND RECONCILIATION ═══ |  |  |
| Individual contributions carried at 2 decimals | YES | Every S21.G00.81 amount. Rounding the individual line to the euro breaks the reconciliation below. |
| Aggregate contributions rounded to the whole euro | YES | Social Security Code art. L130-1 rounds the AGGREGATE, never the individual line. |
| The reconciliation that must hold | YES | Sum of the individual contribution blocks for a contribution code, rounded once at the end, equals the aggregate contribution block for that code, which equals the amount in the payment block. A system that rounds each employee then sums will fail it. |
| Negative amounts | YES | 55 rubriques in the norm carry a pattern that permits a leading minus. The general reduction and the overtime deduction rely on it. |
| ═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══ |  |  |
| An employee with no certified social security number | YES | Declared on a temporary technical number (S21.G00.30.020) until the identification return certifies a NIR. The contract still reports, but entitlement does not post until certification. |
| An establishment with no AT/MP notification yet | YES | Declared with risk code '999ZZ' and NO rate - the rate rubrique is forbidden in that case (control SIG-11). |
| Alsace-Moselle local scheme members | YES | Carried by S21.G00.70.009 alongside the ordinary affiliation. |
| Employees posted abroad or non-resident for tax | YES | Carried by the worker-abroad rubrique (S21.G00.40.024) and the foreign tax status rubrique (S21.G00.30.022). The non-resident withholding is a distinct mechanism - see FR-DGFIP-001. |
| Arrears paid for a closed period | YES | Contributions attach to the period of employment through the attachment-period rubriques; income tax attaches to the month of payment (Social Security Code art. R242-1; General Tax Code art. 204 B). |

SIRET(14) = SIREN(9) + NIC(5). The SIREN identifies the legal entity and is stable across a change of payroll provider; the NIC identifies the establishment within it and CHANGES when the establishment moves or closes. Both carry a Luhn check digit. Sub-field source: INSEE SIRENE register. Persistence: SIREN for the life of the entity, NIC per establishment. Declare the 13 significant characters only - the 2-character control key printed on the card is NOT part of this rubrique.<br><br>Norm definition, CT2026.1.2, quoted verbatim: « Le numéro d'inscription au répertoire (NIR) est l'identifiant unique et invariable des individus inscrits au répertoire national d'identification des personnes physiques (RNIPP). Ce numéro correspond au numéro de sécurité sociale. Ce numéro est composé de 13 chiffres et d'une clé de 2 chiffres. La clé n'est pas à déclarer dans cette rubrique. Cette rubrique permet la déclaration du NIA (numéro d'immatriculation d'attente attribué par les organismes de protection sociale) en l'absence de NIR. Le NIA est constitué comme un NIR dans l'attente d'être certifié (circulaire DSS/sd4c N° 2012-213 du 1er juin 2012). Le Nir doit avoir la forme SAAMMDDCCCNNN avec : S = sexe de la personne physique doit être égal à 1 ou 2 AA = année de naissance de la personne physique doit être comprise entre 00 et 99 MM = mois de naissance de la personne physique doit être compris entre 01 et 12 ou entre 30 et 42 ou entre 50 et 99 ou égal à 20 DD = département de naissance de la personne physique doit être compris entre 01 et 99 ou être égal à 2A ou 2B CCC = commune de naissance de la personne physique doit être comprise entre 001 et 999 NNN = numéro d'inscription la personne physique au registre d'état civil doit être compris entre 001 et 999 ATTENTION : Un NIR ne peut être présent qu'une seule fois dans la déclaration, il doit être unique pour permettre la traçabilité et l'identification de l'individu. Si l'immatriculation est provisoire, ne pas utiliser les numéros provisoires reconnaissables par leur premier caractère égal à 7 ou 8, mais utiliser le NIA qui a été notifié. En l'absence de NIR ou de NIA, il est obligatoire de remplir la rubrique Numéro technique temporaire (S21.G00.30.020). »<br><br>Composite key, 13 characters: position 1 sex (1 male, 2 female), positions 2-3 year of birth, positions 4-5 month of birth, positions 6-7 department of birth, positions 8-10 municipality of birth, positions 11-13 birth sequence number. The 2-digit control key that completes the printed 15-character social security number is NOT declared here. Sourced from the employee's social security card and certified back by the identification return; persists for life, and changes only on a state civil-status correction, which is then carried in the S21.G00.31 change block.<br><br>Composite Key Structure. The NIR is not an opaque number: its 13 significant digits decompose as S(1) sex, 1 male / 2 female - YY(2) year of birth - MM(2) month of birth - DD(2) INSEE department of birth, Corsica coded 2A and 2B and 99 for a birth abroad - CCC(3) INSEE commune code - OOO(3) order number within that commune and month. A 2-digit control key, 97 minus (the 13-digit number modulo 97), is held alongside it for capture validation but is NOT transmitted in this rubrique. Sub-field source: INSEE RNIPP. Persistence: allocated once for life and never reissued. Pour le salarié relevant de la Caisse de Retraite du Personnel Navigant Professionnel de l'Aéronautique Civile il est nécessaire de préciser pour la catégorie des officiers, navigants techniques et cadres navigants commerciaux de l'aéronautique civile (Code PCS-ESE = 389b), les codes compléments PCS-ESE suivants : - C389M pour les cadres navigants commerciaux cotisant à un taux majoré - C389N pour les cadres navigants commerciaux cotisant à un taux normal - T389M pour les navigants techniques cotisant à un taux majoré - T389N pour les navigants techniques cotisant à un taux normal Pour les hôtesses et stewards, (Code PCS-ESE = 546d) alors il convient de renseigner les valeurs suivantes en code complément PCS-ESE : - 546dM pour les hôtesses ou stewards cotisant à un taux majoré - 546dN pour les hôtesses ou stewards cotisant à un taux normal Pour les journalistes (Code PCS-ESE = 352a) il est nécessaire de distinguer avec un code complément PCS-ESE les journalistes professionnels (avec carte de presse) code complément PCS-ESE = P352, des journalistes non professionnels (sans carte de presse) avec un code complément PCS-ESE= NP352. Les représentants exclusifs ou multicartes, cadets de golf doivent être signalés dans cette rubrique. Pour les chauffeurs livreurs, coursiers il est nécessaire de préciser le code PCS-ESE par C643 pour les coursiers ou L643 pour les chauffeurs livreurs. Pour les individus affiliés à la CPRPF, il est nécessaire de renseigner un emploi-type faisant partie d'une des valeurs de la liste extraite du référentiel des emplois commun à toutes les entreprises de l'UTP (Union des Transports Publics et ferroviaires) et intégrée dans la table CCP - Code Complément PCS-ESE.​ La table NEH détermine la structure hiérarchique des emplois relevant de la fonction publique hospitalière. Les établissements sanitaires, sociaux et médico-sociaux publics relevant de l'IRCANTEC doivent utiliser les codes de la table NEH pour définir le statut d'emploi de leur personnel médical hospitalier. Cette table est disponible sur le site http://www.net-entreprises.fr. Dans cette rubrique, la table NNE permet de déterminer le grade des fonctionnaires de l’Etat ou des agents occupant au sein de l’Etat un emploi fonctionnel. Aucun code présent dans cette table n’est à renseigner pour les autres agents de la Fonction publique (exemple : agents contractuels). Pour l'ensemble des professions du spectacle, il est nécessaire de compléter le code complément PCS-ESE par le code détaillé des professions du spectacle. La table de nomenclature des emplois du spectacle est disponible sur le site http://www.net-entreprises.fr. Le portage salarial est une relation contractuelle tripartite dans laquelle un salarié porté ayant un contrat de travail avec une entreprise de portage salarial effectue une prestation pour le compte d'entreprises clientes. Les groupements d'employeurs sont des groupements de personnes entrant dans le champ d'application d'une même convention collective. Ils peuvent être constitués dans le but de mettre à la disposition de leurs membres des salariés liés à ces groupements par un contrat de travail. Les entreprises adaptées permettent à des travailleurs handicapés d'exercer une activité professionnelle dans des conditions adaptées à leurs possibilités. La valeur "03 - Individu d'une entreprise adaptée mis à disposition" est à renseigner lorsqu'un individu handicapé employé par une entreprise adaptée est mis à disposition dans une autre entreprise (SIREN différent). L'entreprise adaptée déclare cette rubrique et indique au niveau de la rubrique "Identifiant du lieu de travail - S21.G00.40.019" le lieu de travail effectif de l'individu en renseignant le SIRET de l'entreprise utilisatrice. » | Yes - payroll master data, supplied to the filing from employee or employer records | Field Options: S21.G00.40.074 (7 values) | Not applicable - not a numeric field. | N | Code - Input | Per DSN Mensuelle |  |  |

Pour le salarié relevant de la Caisse de Retraite du Personnel Navigant Professionnel de l'Aéronautique Civile il est nécessaire de préciser pour la catégorie des officiers, navigants techniques et cadres navigants commerciaux de l'aéronautique civile (Code PCS-ESE = 389b), les codes compléments PCS-ESE suivants : - C389M pour les cadres navigants commerciaux cotisant à un taux majoré - C389N pour les cadres navigants commerciaux cotisant à un taux normal - T389M pour les navigants techniques cotisant à un taux majoré - T389N pour les navigants techniques cotisant à un taux normal Pour les hôtesses et stewards, (Code PCS-ESE = 546d) alors il convient de renseigner les valeurs suivantes en code complément PCS-ESE : - 546dM pour les hôtesses ou stewards cotisant à un taux majoré - 546dN pour les hôtesses ou stewards cotisant à un taux normal Pour les journalistes (Code PCS-ESE = 352a) il est nécessaire de distinguer avec un code complément PCS-ESE les journalistes professionnels (avec carte de presse) code complément PCS-ESE = P352, des journalistes non professionnels (sans carte de presse) avec un code complément PCS-ESE= NP352. Les représentants exclusifs ou multicartes, cadets de golf doivent être signalés dans cette rubrique. Pour les chauffeurs livreurs, coursiers il est nécessaire de préciser le code PCS-ESE par C643 pour les coursiers ou L643 pour les chauffeurs livreurs. Pour les individus affiliés à la CPRPF, il est nécessaire de renseigner un emploi-type faisant partie d'une des valeurs de la liste extraite du référentiel des emplois commun à toutes les entreprises de l'UTP (Union des Transports Publics et ferroviaires) et intégrée dans la table CCP - Code Complément PCS-ESE. ​ La table NEH détermine la structure hiérarchique des emplois relevant de la fonction publique hospitalière. Les établissements sanitaires, sociaux et médico-sociaux publics relevant de l'IRCANTEC doivent utiliser les codes de la table NEH pour définir le statut d'emploi de leur personnel médical hospitalier. Cette table est disponible sur le site http://www.net-entreprises.fr. Dans cette rubrique, la table NNE permet de déterminer le grade des fonctionnaires de l’Etat ou des agents occupant au sein de l’Etat un emploi fonctionnel. Aucun code présent dans cette table n’est à renseigner pour les autres agents de la Fonction publique (exemple : agents contractuels). Pour l'ensemble des professions du spectacle, il est nécessaire de compléter le code complément PCS-ESE par le code détaillé des professions du spectacle. La table de nomenclature des emplois du spectacle est disponible sur le site http://www.net-entreprises.fr. Les emplois de la fonction publique sont classés en trois catégories : • catégorie sédentaire (A) code 01 : ce sont tous les emplois qui ne sont pas classés en catégorie active • catégorie active (B) code 02 : ce sont des emplois qui présentent un risque particulier ou des fatigues exceptionnelles justifiant un départ anticipé à la retraite. • catégorie insalubre (C) codes 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08 ce sont des emplois qui correspondent aux agents des réseaux souterrains des égouts et aux agents du corps des identificateurs de l’institut médico-légal de la préfecture de police de Paris. Les valeurs "10" à "49" et "80" à "82" désignent les fonctions du marin occupées lors d'une période de ligne de service. Pour les industries électriques et gazières (IEG), la catégorie de service permet de distinguer les différentes associations de type et motif de service actif. Pour la CPRPF, la catégorie de service permet de renseigner l'indicateur de pénibilité. » | Yes - payroll master data, supplied to the filing from employee or employer records | Field Options: S21.G00.41.033 (86 values) | Not applicable - not a numeric field. | N | Code - Input | Per DSN Mensuelle |  |  |

Ne pas utiliser les numéros provisoires reconnaissables par leur premier caractère égal à 7 ou 8. »<br><br>Composite Key Structure. The NIR is not an opaque number: its 13 significant digits decompose as S(1) sex, 1 male / 2 female - YY(2) year of birth - MM(2) month of birth - DD(2) INSEE department of birth, Corsica coded 2A and 2B and 99 for a birth abroad - CCC(3) INSEE commune code - OOO(3) order number within that commune and month. A 2-digit control key, 97 minus (the 13-digit number modulo 97), is held alongside it for capture validation but is NOT transmitted in this rubrique. Sub-field source: INSEE RNIPP. Pour plus de précisions sur les éléments de salaires à intégrer dans les bases de cotisations CIBTP se référer au document de référence disponible sur www.cibtp.fr. Pour la base brute de cotisations OPPBTP permanents, indiquez le montant brut sans application du coefficient de majoration. Les valeurs « 36 - CIBTP - Base de cotisations dérogatoire Bâtiment », « 39 - CIBTP - Base de cotisations dérogatoire Travaux Publics » et « 40 - CIBTP - Base de cotisations dérogatoire Partenaires Bâtiment » renvoient aux cotisations pour lesquelles la caisse CIBTP et les organisations professionnelles du BTP ont signé des conventions de mandat pour la perception des cotisations professionnelles. La définition de ces bases est à apporter par les caisses CIBTP. La base IRCANTEC cotisée sert au calcul de l’assiette IRCANTEC pour la période de cotisation et le contrat déclarés. Pour les personnels médicaux hospitaliers relevant de l'IRCANTEC, la base est constitué des émoluments et des indemnités soumis à cotisations IRCANTEC définis par la règlementation. Certaines indemnités peuvent donc ne pas être soumises. Un taux est appliqué à cette base en fonction de l’emploi statutaire du personnel médical hospitalier pour déterminer l’assiette de cotisation. L'assiette caisse de congés spectacles correspond à la rémunération brute acquise par le salarié durant la période de référence, avant toute déduction forfaitaire spécifique pour frais professionnels et toute retenue. En application de l'article D7121-37 du code du travail, les partenaires sociaux d'une branche d'activité ou d'une entreprise peuvent limiter ce montant à un plafond d'indemnité journalière. Pour le régime des pensions civiles et militaires (SRE), la base assujettie est le traitement indiciaire brut éventuellement augmenté de la NBI ou de prime et indemnité. Une attention particulière doit être observée pour les fonctionnaires bénéficiant d'indemnité de sujétion. Conditional in declaration nature '01 - DSN Mensuelle'.<br><br>Norm definition, CT2026.1.2, quoted verbatim: « Le numéro d'inscription au répertoire (NIR) est l'identifiant unique et invariable des individus inscrits au répertoire national d'identification des personnes physiques (RNIPP). Ce numéro correspond au numéro de sécurité sociale. Ce numéro est composé de 13 chiffres et d'une clé de 2 chiffres. La clé n'est pas à déclarer dans cette rubrique. Cette rubrique permet la déclaration du NIA (numéro d'immatriculation d'attente attribué par les organismes de protection sociale) en l'absence de NIR. Le NIA est constitué comme un NIR dans l'attente d'être certifié (circulaire DSS/sd4c N° 2012-213 du 1er juin 2012). Le NIR doit avoir la forme SAAMMDDCCCNNN avec : S = sexe de la personne physique doit être égal à 1 ou 2 AA = année de naissance de la personne physique doit être comprise entre 00 et 99 MM = mois de naissance de la personne physique doit être compris entre 01 et 12 ou entre 30 et 42 ou entre 50 et 99 ou égal à 20 DD = département de naissance de la personne physique doit être compris entre 01 et 99 ou être égal à 2A ou 2B CCC = commune de naissance de la personne physique doit être comprise entre 001 et 999 NNN = numéro d'inscription la personne physique au registre d'état civil doit être compris entre 001 et 999. Si l'immatriculation est provisoire, ne pas utiliser les numéros provisoires reconnaissables par leur premier caractère égal à 7 ou 8, mais utiliser le NIA qui a été notifié. En l'absence de NIR ou de NIA, il est obligatoire de remplir la rubrique Numéro technique temporaire (S89.G00.67.002). » | Yes - payroll master data, supplied to the filing from employee or employer records | Not a coded field | Not applicable - not a numeric field. | N | Identifier - Input | Per DSN Mensuelle |  |  |

Conditional in declaration nature '01 - DSN Mensuelle'.<br><br>Norm definition, CT2026.1.2, quoted verbatim: « Le NTT est un identifiant technique unique et invariant permettant à l'employeur de déclarer, dans un temps limité, un individu pour lequel il n'aurait pas connaissance du Numéro d'Inscription au Répertoire ou du Numéro d'Identification d'Attente au moment de l'émission d'une DSN. Il est composé du code sexe de la personne physique qui doit être égal à 1 ou 2, suivi du SIREN de l'entreprise et d'un identifiant unique et pérenne de l'individu dans l'entreprise, comme le Matricule du salarié dans l'entreprise par exemple. Il ne peut pas contenir de caractères "espace". Il s'agit d'une donnée technique destinée au système d'information DSN uniquement. Le NTT n'est pas une donnée de gestion et ne permet pas l'ouverture des droits de l'individu auprès des organismes de protection sociale. Le NTT doit désigner un individu et un seul pour l'ensemble de ses contrats dans l'entreprise. En cas d'obtention de plusieurs NTT, l'employeur doit utiliser pour ses déclarations le NTT le plus ancien en cours de validité. En l'absence de NIR ou de NIA, il est obligatoire de remplir la rubrique Numéro technique temporaire (S89.G00.67.002). Le NTT doit être renseigné dans la première DSN où le NIR est attribué. Le NTT n'est pas une donnée de gestion et ne permet pas l'ouverture des droits de l'individu auprès des organismes de protection sociale. Le NTT doit désigner un individu et un seul pour l'ensemble de ses contrats dans l'entreprise. En cas d'obtention de plusieurs NTT, l'employeur doit utiliser pour ses déclarations le NTT le plus ancien en cours de validité. En l'absence de NIR ou de NIA, il est obligatoire de remplir la rubrique Numéro technique temporaire (S89.G00.88.009). Le NTT doit être renseigné sur la première DSN où le NIR est attribué. ## Sheet: `File Structure`

_98 rows x 1 columns._

```text
DSN Mensuelle - Monthly Nominative Social Declaration — FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

═══ FILE FORMAT ═══
Norm            : NEODeS, cahier technique CT2026.1.2 (P26V01,
revision 20251224, release 2026.1.0.9).
Physical form   : a flat text file, one rubrique per record. The norm
states the record layout as  [Sxx.Gyy.zz.aaa,'value']
and gives as its own example:
S21.G00.06.001,'332975200'
There is no XML, no XSD and no fixed-width layout.
A build that assumes XML here is wrong.
Field separator : the comma, hex 2C.
Value delimiter : the apostrophe, hex 27, on both sides of the value.
Record delimiter: CR-LF (hex 0D0A) or LF (hex 0A) alone. Both accepted.
Encoding        : ISO/IEC 8859-1 (E), alphabet Latin-1. Named by the norm
as THE usable character table - not UTF-8.
Extension       : .txt (also accepted inside a .zip for bulk deposit).
Record length   : variable, maximum 256 ASCII characters per record.
The per-value length constraint is the rubrique's own,
from its data type.
(cahier technique CT2026.1.2, section 3, p.77)
Declaration     : nature '01 - DSN Mensuelle'
carried in S20.G00.05.001.

═══ STRUCTURAL HIERARCHY ═══
The file is a strict nesting of blocks. A child block may only appear
inside its parent, and the cardinality shown is the norm's own.

S10.G00.00  Envoi                                   {1,1}
S10.G00.01  Emetteur                              {1,1}
S10.G00.02  Contact Emetteur                      {1,1}
S20.G00.05  Declaration                           {1,*}
S21.G00.06  Entreprise                          {1,1}
S21.G00.11  Etablissement                     {1,*}
S21.G00.30  Individu                        {0,*}
S21.G00.40  Contrat                       {1,*}
S21.G00.50  Versement individu          {1,*}
S21.G00.51  Remuneration              {0,*}
S21.G00.78  Base assujettie           {0,*}
S21.G00.81  Cotisation individuelle {0,*}
S21.G00.22  Bordereau de cotisation due     {0,*}
S21.G00.23  Cotisation agregee            {0,*}
S21.G00.20  Versement organisme             {0,*}
S90.G00.90  Total de l'envoi                        {1,1}

The exact block set carried by THIS declaration nature is the one
listed on the spec sheet; blocks the norm forbids for this nature are
shown there as excluded rather than omitted.

═══ TRANSMISSION AND CHANNEL ═══
Channel  : file_upload - a file generated by the payroll software and
deposited on the portal, or sent machine-to-machine via the
same platform's API.
Portal   : net-entreprises.fr, operated by GIP-MDS.
https://www.net-entreprises.fr/
Deposit  : S10.G00.00.007 = '01 - Net-entreprises'. Value '02 - MSA' is
the agricultural channel and is out of scope for this build.
Test mode: S10.G00.00.005 = '01 - envoi fichier test' routes the file
to the test environment. Conformity is proved with the free
self-check tool before going live; there is no product
certification for France (FR-CCG-001 Module 10.4).
Mandate  : a service provider filing on a client's behalf must be
registered on net-entreprises.fr and hold the client's
mandate. That is a registration, not a software approval.

═══ DEADLINE AND PAYMENT ═══
Deadline : the 5th of the following month for employers of 50 or
more employees paying wages in the same month; the 15th
for all others. Postponed to the next working day where
it falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday.
(Social Security Code arts. R133-13 to R133-14)
Payment  : the social contributions AND the income tax withheld are
collected by DIRECT DEBIT initiated from this same file.
The employer authorises the debit; it does not push a
payment. Remittance of the withholding is due the 8th of
the following month for employers of 50 or more, the 18th
otherwise.
Penalty  : late filing, omission of an employee or inaccurate data
each attract a penalty expressed as a fraction of the
monthly social security ceiling per employee per month.

═══ RETURN FLOWS PRODUCED AGAINST THIS FILE ═══
This filing is only half of the obligation. Five return flows come
back and must be consumed - they are specified separately:

FR-DGFIP-002   withholding rate return (compte rendu metier PAS)
the ONLY lawful source of an employee's rate
FR-URSSAF-002  identification and anomaly returns, plus the
annual reminder issued in March
FR-AGIRC-001   supplementary pension membership and point
allocation feedback
FR-CARSAT-001  occupational-accident rate notification
FR-CPAM-003    daily benefit statements where subrogated

From June 2026 an anomaly left uncorrected on the CAPPED GROSS BASE
may be corrected by URSSAF itself under the substituted-declaration
power, with the corrected figure sent to the pension bodies. An
uncorrected anomaly is therefore no longer merely untidy.
```

## Sheet: `Population Rules`

_27 rows x 5 columns._

| Rule Category | Field Name | Source System | Population Logic | Edge Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ═══ MANDATORY FIELD RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Envelope | S10.G00.00.006 - NEODeS norm version | Product build constant | Must be exactly 'P26V01' for the 2026 filing year. This is not a configuration item and must not be exposed to the client: a file built to the 2025 norm is rejected on deposit from the January 2026 period onwards, and a file built to the 2027 norm is rejected before that norm's production date. | A client running a January 2026 payroll in December 2025 for an early pay date still files under P26V01, because the norm follows the declared period, not the run date. |
| Envelope | S10.G00.00.005 - test or live indicator | Filing component | Must be '01 - envoi fichier test' for every file sent to the test environment during implementation and '02 - envoi fichier reel' thereafter. Leaving it at '01' in production means the file is accepted, acknowledged, and never processed - the failure looks like success, which is why this is the single most important switch in the envelope. | Cut-over: the flag must flip in the same release as the first live period, and the first live deposit must be reconciled against the portal dashboard rather than against the local acknowledgement. |
| Identification | S21.G00.06.001 + S21.G00.11.001 - SIREN and NIC | Employer master data | Concatenated they form the 14-character SIRET that identifies the declared establishment; every per-employee block in the file hangs off that pair. The SIREN must be ACTIVE in the INSEE SIRENE register on the declared date (control CME-11) - a SIREN that is structurally valid but closed is rejected. | Relocation issues a new NIC while the SIREN is unchanged. From the period of the move the file must be filed under the new SIRET, with the change carried in the appropriate change block; continuing to file under the old SIRET does not fail structure validation but misroutes the whole establishment. |
| Identification | S21.G00.30.001 - employee NIR | Employee master data, certified by FR-URSSAF-002 | Declare the 13 significant characters only; the 2-character control key printed on the social security card is NOT part of this rubrique and including it fails the length check. The value must come from the employee's own card or from a certified identification return - never from a form the employee filled in from memory, which is the commonest source of a rejected identification. | Where no NIR is held, populate the temporary technical number (S21.G00.30.020) instead and carry it unchanged until the identification return supplies a certified NIR. |
| ═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Rounding | S21.G00.81.004 vs S21.G00.23.005 | Payroll calculation | Carry every individual contribution at 2 decimals. Sum the individual contributions for a contribution code across the establishment. Round that sum ONCE, half-up, to the whole euro, and declare it in the aggregate block. Social Security Code art. L130-1 applies the rounding to the aggregate and never to the individual line, so a system that rounds each employee and then sums will produce an aggregate that does not tie back. | With 400 employees, per-line rounding drifts by up to 200 euro against the true aggregate. The deposit does not reject it - the divergence surfaces later as an URSSAF anomaly on the bordereau. |
| Period attachment | S21.G00.78.002 / .003 - base attachment period | Payroll calculation | Every contribution base carries the start and end of the period it attaches to. Arrears, retroactive pay awards and corrections must carry the ORIGINAL period, not the current month, so that the collecting body applies that period's rates and ceiling and posts the entitlement to the right year. Adding a prior-period amount to the current month's base without carrying the period is the error inspections find most often. | A pay award backdated to January and paid in June produces five base blocks with January-to-May attachment periods, not one June block. Income tax, by contrast, attaches to the month of PAYMENT - the two rules genuinely differ and must not be unified. |
| Withholding | S21.G00.50.009 vs .002 and .006 | Payroll calculation | The income tax withheld is validated on deposit against net taxable remuneration multiplied by the rate applied, with a tolerance of plus or minus one euro. A mismatch outside that tolerance is returned as an anomaly. The three values must therefore come from one calculation, not from three independently stored figures. | Where a mid-month rate change applies, the rate declared must be the one actually used for the payment, and the rate identifier (S21.G00.50.008) must be the identifier of the return that supplied it - not the most recent one held. |
| AT/MP | S21.G00.40.040 and .043 | CARSAT notification via FR-CARSAT-001 | The pair is mutually constrained: where the risk code is '999ZZ' (no notification received yet), the rate rubrique is FORBIDDEN; in every other case the rate is mandatory (control SIG-11). Neither is ever computed by payroll - both are read from the compte AT/MP notification, per SIRET. | A client whose notification arrives in February must be filed on '999ZZ' for January and then regularised. Guessing the rate from the national average (2.08% for 2026) produces a file that passes validation and under- or over-collects for the whole year. |
| Structural | S20.G00.05.001 - declaration nature | Filing component | The nature governs the obligation of every other rubrique in the file. 205 rubriques are mandatory and 337 conditional in the monthly declaration; in the end-of-contract signal 101 are mandatory, 125 conditional and 78 FORBIDDEN. A filing component that emits one field set and varies only the nature code will be rejected on the forbidden fields. | The obligation matrix is reproduced per filing on each spec sheet's column F, so the field set can be driven from the spec rather than from an assumption. |
| ═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Format | All amount rubriques | Payroll calculation | Amounts are written with a full stop as decimal separator and exactly two decimals, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol - the norm's own pattern is [1-9][0-9]*\.[0-9]{2}, and to the left of the separator the first digit must not be zero except for values below one. A leading minus is permitted only on the 55 rubriques whose pattern begins -?. | Writing '1 234,56' or '1234.5' fails structure validation. Writing '0.00' is accepted only where the rubrique's pattern admits it - some amount patterns explicitly exclude zero. |
| Format | All rate rubriques | Payroll calculation / authority notification | Rates are written as a percentage value with two decimals, not as a decimal fraction: an occupational-accident rate of 2.08% is written '2.08', not '0.0208'. Several rate patterns cap the integer part at two digits, so a rate above 99.99 cannot be expressed and indicates a unit error upstream. | The withholding rate follows the same convention: a 7.5% rate is '7.50'. |
| Format | All date rubriques | Payroll and master data | Dates are written DDMMYYYY with no separators - '15012026' is 15 January 2026. The norm validates the day, month and century ranges by pattern, so an ISO date, a US-ordered date or a two-digit year all fail structure validation rather than being silently reinterpreted. | A handful of rubriques use MMYYYY (6 characters) instead - the month of the error in the withholding-correction block is one. Read the length from column I rather than assuming eight. |
| ═══ PAYROLL-SPECIFIC POPULATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Intermediates | Contribution bases | Payroll calculation - must be STORED, not derived at reporting time | France requires the engine to expose quantities that are not shown on the payslip and are not needed to compute net pay: the capped gross base after progressive ceiling reconciliation, the uncapped gross base, supplementary pension bands 1 and 2 separately, the unemployment base capped at four ceilings, and the social levies base distinguishing the 98.25% fraction from the 100% fraction. Each must be a first-class stored value. | Deriving them at reporting time from the payslip cannot reproduce the progressive ceiling reconciliation, because that depends on the cumulative position across the year and not on the month in isolation. |
| Intermediates | Net social amount and net taxable amount | Payroll calculation | Both are statutory quantities with legal definitions, and both must be one stored value feeding BOTH the DSN and the payslip. The net social amount is used by the benefits authorities to assess the earned-income top-up and the active-solidarity income; the net taxable amount is the base of the withholding and pre-fills the employee's own tax return. | Computing them separately for the payslip and for the declaration is the classic way to produce a payslip that does not tie to the declaration, and the employee sees both. |
| Headcount | Average annual headcount of the legal entity | Employer master data, recomputed annually | It determines the DSN deadline (5th vs 15th), the housing-fund rate, the training rate, the mobility-levy liability and the disabled-worker obligation. It is a single derived figure with wide blast radius, so it must be computed once, stored, and dated - not recomputed independently by each consumer. | The 2026 headcount is computed on the 2025 average. A client crossing 50 employees changes its filing deadline from the 15th to the 5th, which is a nine-day swing in the payroll calendar. |
| Hours | Hours paid and hours worked, separately | Payroll calculation | The two are different quantities and both are required: hours paid drives entitlement calculations, hours worked drives the working-time record. A day-count (forfait jours) or annualised arrangement reports the nature and duration of the arrangement instead of hours, through the working-time unit and arrangement rubriques. | Paid leave is paid but not worked; short-time working is neither fully. Collapsing the two into one figure is not recoverable downstream. |
| ═══ CROSS-FIELD VALIDATIONS ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.40.040 (risk code) <-> S21.G00.40.043 (AT/MP rate) | CARSAT notification | Each field's Conditional Reason names the other, and the constraint runs both ways: risk code '999ZZ' FORBIDS the rate; any other risk code REQUIRES it. Control SIG-11 is written as an if-and-only-if, so there is no state in which both are optional and none in which both are absent for an employee covered by the general scheme. | This is the pattern the C16 check looks for: a conditional field that names its counterpart, and a counterpart that names it back. |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.50.007 (rate type) <-> S21.G00.50.006 / .008 / .009 | Payroll calculation and FR-DGFIP-002 | Rate type '01 - Taux transmis par la DGFIP' REQUIRES the rate identifier .008 (control CCH-11). Rate type '99 - indu relatif a un exercice anterieur' FORBIDS the rate .006 and the identifier .008. The withheld amount .009 is validated against .002 times .006. All four move together. | An over-payment recovered from a closed year is the case that exercises type 99, and it is the one most often coded as an ordinary negative payment - which fails on the rate cross-check. |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.40.039 (AT/MP scheme) <-> S21.G00.40.040 (risk code) | Employer master data | Scheme '300 - regime agricole' constrains the risk code to the agricultural 'RA' prefix (control CCH-15) and, conversely, an 'RA' risk code requires scheme 300. For this build the scheme is always '200 - regime general (CNAM)', and an RA-prefixed code would indicate an MSA employee wrongly in the general-scheme file. | See scope_manifest FR-MSA-001: agricultural employers file through a different channel entirely. |
| Reconciliation across blocks | S21.G00.81 -> S21.G00.23 -> S21.G00.20 | Payroll calculation | Three levels must tie: the individual contributions, the aggregate per contribution code, and the payment to each collecting body. The tie is computed once, at the aggregate, with a single rounding step. This is the arithmetic backbone of the whole declaration and the first thing an URSSAF inspection reconstructs. | Where a correction for a closed period is included, it enters at the individual level with its own attachment period but still rolls into the current month's aggregate and payment - the period travels with the base, not with the payment. |
| Forbidden-field discipline | Every rubrique marked 'N' in column F | Filing component | Column F carries the norm's own per-nature obligation. Where the norm marks a rubrique FORBIDDEN for this declaration nature, populating it is a structure rejection and not a warning. The Conditional Reason column says so explicitly for each such field, so the filing component can be driven from the spec. | 19 rubriques are forbidden even in the monthly declaration - mostly public-service and exit-request fields. In the end-of-contract signal the forbidden count is 78. |

## Sheet: `Payroll Scope Summary`

_35 rows x 3 columns._

**DSN Signalement Fin du Contrat de Travail Unique (FCTU) — PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY**

**Tells the developer WHICH contract endings produce a signal, WHAT travels with it, and - critically - what the signal does NOT discharge. Transmitting the FCTU does not relieve the employer of handing the employee a signed France Travail statement, a work certificate and a final settlement statement on the last day of work.**

| ITEM / SCENARIO | IN SCOPE? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|
| ═══ WHO GETS REPORTED ═══ |  |  |
| Every employee whose contract ends, whatever the reason | YES | Resignation, dismissal, end of a fixed term, mutually agreed termination, retirement - all produce a signal. The reason code distinguishes them. |
| An employee whose fixed-term contract reaches its planned end | YES | Reported like any other end of contract. Where the client uses customary fixed-term contracts (contrat d'usage) the declaration method rubrique governs how repeated short contracts are signalled. |
| An employee who refuses a permanent contract offered after a fixed-term or agency contract | YES | Carried by its own rubrique in the end-of-contract block, because it affects the unemployment entitlement. |
| An employee transferred under a transfer of undertaking | NO | Labour Code arts. L1224-1 to L1224-4: the contract SUBSISTS with the new employer. There is no end of contract and no signal - the new employer continues the same contract and regularises the ceiling as though it had been the employer since 1 January. |
| An employee whose contract is suspended | NO | Suspension is not termination. A work stoppage is FR-DSN-003; other suspensions are carried in the monthly DSN. |
| A cancelled contract that never started | NO | Reported as a cancellation through the termination reason '099 - annulation', not as an ordinary end of contract. The distinction matters: an annulation suppresses the contract rather than closing it. |
| Freelancers and suppliers invoicing for services | NO | Not employees. Fees are an accounts-payable obligation carried by the S89.G00.32 fee-reporting vehicle, not by payroll. |
| Employees of the agricultural scheme (MSA) | NO | Separate collection network and separate deposit channel. Descoped as FR-MSA-001. |
| Public-service employees (fonction publique) | NO | Out of scope per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt. The norm's [FP] rubriques are shown on the spec sheet as excluded. |
| Employees under a regime special (RATP, ENIM, CNIEG, CRPCEN, CNBF, CAVIMAC) | NO | Out of scope per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt, which locks this build to the regime general. |
| ═══ WHAT GETS REPORTED ═══ |  |  |
| The termination reason | YES | One of 54 codes. It determines the unemployment entitlement, so it is the highest-consequence field in the signal. |
| The contract end date and the last day worked and paid | YES | Two distinct dates: the last day worked at the usual salary can precede the contract end where notice is not worked. |
| Notice: dates, and whether it was worked or paid | YES | In the notice block S21.G00.63, together with the notice indemnity that would have been paid where notice was waived. |
| The pay history France Travail needs | YES | This is what makes the FCTU 'unique': remuneration, bonuses, activity and other gross elements travel WITH the signal rather than being reconstructed from the monthly filings. |
| Severance and termination indemnities | YES | In the bonus and indemnity blocks, by type code. Their social and tax treatment - including the 40% employer contribution on mutually-agreed terminations and compulsory retirement - is settled in the monthly DSN, not here. |
| Continuation of supplementary cover after departure | YES | Carried by the maintenance-of-membership rubrique in the end-of-contract block. |
| The final settlement statement (recu pour solde de tout compte) | NO | A paper document handed to the employee, not a DSN datum. Due on the last day of work, alongside the work certificate. |
| The work certificate (certificat de travail) | NO | Also a paper document. It may NOT be withheld pending payment. |
| ═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══ |  |  |
| Filed within 5 days of the employer learning of the event | YES | Not within 5 days of the contract ending - of the employer LEARNING of it, which can be later for a resignation notified late. |
| Also reported in the monthly DSN for the period | YES | The contract end is carried again in the monthly declaration. The signal does not replace the monthly filing, and the two must agree. |
| The signal discharges the duty to give the employee a signed statement | NO | It does not. Transmission through the DSN and handing the employee a signed copy are COMPLEMENTARY acts - this is the single most common misreading of the French end-of-contract process. |
| An amending or cancelling signal where the first was wrong | YES | Sent under the same nature with the appropriate declaration type. |
| ═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══ |  |  |
| Death of the employee in service | YES | An end of contract with its own reason code. |
| Termination for occupational unfitness | YES | Reported with its own reason code; the statutory redundancy payment is doubled (Labour Code art. L1226-14), which is settled in payroll and reported in the monthly DSN. |
| Employee joining the professional security contract (CSP) | YES | The notice months used in the CSP calculation have their own rubrique in the end-of-contract block. |
| An employee in a sector paid-leave fund | YES | The signal still applies, but the employer pays NO compensatory leave indemnity on termination - the fund does. A general-regime payroll configuration is wrong for these clients (scope_manifest FR-CIBTP-001). |

Declare the 13 significant characters only - the 2-character control key printed on the card is NOT part of this rubrique.<br><br>Norm definition, CT2026.1.2, quoted verbatim: « Le numéro d'inscription au répertoire (NIR) est l'identifiant unique et invariable des individus inscrits au répertoire national d'identification des personnes physiques (RNIPP). Ce numéro correspond au numéro de sécurité sociale. Ce numéro est composé de 13 chiffres et d'une clé de 2 chiffres. La clé n'est pas à déclarer dans cette rubrique. Cette rubrique permet la déclaration du NIA (numéro d'immatriculation d'attente attribué par les organismes de protection sociale) en l'absence de NIR. Le NIA est constitué comme un NIR dans l'attente d'être certifié (circulaire DSS/sd4c N° 2012-213 du 1er juin 2012). Le Nir doit avoir la forme SAAMMDDCCCNNN avec : S = sexe de la personne physique doit être égal à 1 ou 2 AA = année de naissance de la personne physique doit être comprise entre 00 et 99 MM = mois de naissance de la personne physique doit être compris entre 01 et 12 ou entre 30 et 42 ou entre 50 et 99 ou égal à 20 DD = département de naissance de la personne physique doit être compris entre 01 et 99 ou être égal à 2A ou 2B CCC = commune de naissance de la personne physique doit être comprise entre 001 et 999 NNN = numéro d'inscription la personne physique au registre d'état civil doit être compris entre 001 et 999 ATTENTION : Un NIR ne peut être présent qu'une seule fois dans la déclaration, il doit être unique pour permettre la traçabilité et l'identification de l'individu. Si l'immatriculation est provisoire, ne pas utiliser les numéros provisoires reconnaissables par leur premier caractère égal à 7 ou 8, mais utiliser le NIA qui a été notifié. En l'absence de NIR ou de NIA, il est obligatoire de remplir la rubrique Numéro technique temporaire (S21.G00.30.020). »<br><br>Composite key, 13 characters: position 1 sex (1 male, 2 female), positions 2-3 year of birth, positions 4-5 month of birth, positions 6-7 department of birth, positions 8-10 municipality of birth, positions 11-13 birth sequence number. The 2-digit control key that completes the printed 15-character social security number is NOT declared here. Sourced from the employee's social security card and certified back by the identification return; persists for life, and changes only on a state civil-status correction, which is then carried in the S21.G00.31 change block.<br><br>Composite Key Structure. The NIR is not an opaque number: its 13 significant digits decompose as S(1) sex, 1 male / 2 female - YY(2) year of birth - MM(2) month of birth - DD(2) INSEE department of birth, Corsica coded 2A and 2B and 99 for a birth abroad - CCC(3) INSEE commune code - OOO(3) order number within that commune and month. A 2-digit control key, 97 minus (the 13-digit number modulo 97), is held alongside it for capture validation but is NOT transmitted in this rubrique. Sub-field source: INSEE RNIPP. Persistence: allocated once for life and never reissued. Les établissements sanitaires, sociaux et médico-sociaux publics relevant de l'IRCANTEC doivent utiliser les codes de la table NEH pour définir le statut d'emploi de leur personnel médical hospitalier. Cette table est disponible sur le site http://www.net-entreprises.fr. Dans cette rubrique, la table NNE permet de déterminer le grade des fonctionnaires de l’Etat ou des agents occupant au sein de l’Etat un emploi fonctionnel. Aucun code présent dans cette table n’est à renseigner pour les autres agents de la Fonction publique (exemple : agents contractuels). Pour l'ensemble des professions du spectacle, il est nécessaire de compléter le code complément PCS-ESE par le code détaillé des professions du spectacle. La table de nomenclature des emplois du spectacle est disponible sur le site http://www.net-entreprises.fr. Pour plus de précisions sur les éléments de salaires à intégrer dans les bases de cotisations CIBTP se référer au document de référence disponible sur www.cibtp.fr. Pour la base brute de cotisations OPPBTP permanents, indiquez le montant brut sans application du coefficient de majoration. Les valeurs « 36 - CIBTP - Base de cotisations dérogatoire Bâtiment », « 39 - CIBTP - Base de cotisations dérogatoire Travaux Publics » et « 40 - CIBTP - Base de cotisations dérogatoire Partenaires Bâtiment » renvoient aux cotisations pour lesquelles la caisse CIBTP et les organisations professionnelles du BTP ont signé des conventions de mandat pour la perception des cotisations professionnelles. La définition de ces bases est à apporter par les caisses CIBTP. La base IRCANTEC cotisée sert au calcul de l’assiette IRCANTEC pour la période de cotisation et le contrat déclarés. Pour les personnels médicaux hospitaliers relevant de l'IRCANTEC, la base est constitué des émoluments et des indemnités soumis à cotisations IRCANTEC définis par la règlementation. Certaines indemnités peuvent donc ne pas être soumises. Un taux est appliqué à cette base en fonction de l’emploi statutaire du personnel médical hospitalier pour déterminer l’assiette de cotisation. L'assiette caisse de congés spectacles correspond à la rémunération brute acquise par le salarié durant la période de référence, avant toute déduction forfaitaire spécifique pour frais professionnels et toute retenue. En application de l'article D7121-37 du code du travail, les partenaires sociaux d'une branche d'activité ou d'une entreprise peuvent limiter ce montant à un plafond d'indemnité journalière. Pour le régime des pensions civiles et militaires (SRE), la base assujettie est le traitement indiciaire brut éventuellement augmenté de la NBI ou de prime et indemnité. Une attention particulière doit être observée pour les fonctionnaires bénéficiant d'indemnité de sujétion. ## Sheet: `File Structure`

_98 rows x 1 columns._

```text
DSN Signalement Fin du Contrat de Travail Unique (FCTU) — FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

═══ FILE FORMAT ═══
Norm            : NEODeS, cahier technique CT2026.1.2 (P26V01,
revision 20251224, release 2026.1.0.9).
Physical form   : a flat text file, one rubrique per record. The norm
states the record layout as  [Sxx.Gyy.zz.aaa,'value']
and gives as its own example:
S21.G00.06.001,'332975200'
There is no XML, no XSD and no fixed-width layout.
A build that assumes XML here is wrong.
Field separator : the comma, hex 2C.
Value delimiter : the apostrophe, hex 27, on both sides of the value.
Record delimiter: CR-LF (hex 0D0A) or LF (hex 0A) alone. Both accepted.
Encoding        : ISO/IEC 8859-1 (E), alphabet Latin-1. Named by the norm
as THE usable character table - not UTF-8.
Extension       : .txt (also accepted inside a .zip for bulk deposit).
Record length   : variable, maximum 256 ASCII characters per record.
The per-value length constraint is the rubrique's own,
from its data type.
(cahier technique CT2026.1.2, section 3, p.77)
Declaration     : nature '07 - Signalement FCTU'
carried in S20.G00.05.001.

═══ STRUCTURAL HIERARCHY ═══
The file is a strict nesting of blocks. A child block may only appear
inside its parent, and the cardinality shown is the norm's own.

S10.G00.00  Envoi                                   {1,1}
S10.G00.01  Emetteur                              {1,1}
S10.G00.02  Contact Emetteur                      {1,1}
S20.G00.05  Declaration                           {1,*}
S21.G00.06  Entreprise                          {1,1}
S21.G00.11  Etablissement                     {1,*}
S21.G00.30  Individu                        {0,*}
S21.G00.40  Contrat                       {1,*}
S21.G00.50  Versement individu          {1,*}
S21.G00.51  Remuneration              {0,*}
S21.G00.78  Base assujettie           {0,*}
S21.G00.81  Cotisation individuelle {0,*}
S21.G00.22  Bordereau de cotisation due     {0,*}
S21.G00.23  Cotisation agregee            {0,*}
S21.G00.20  Versement organisme             {0,*}
S90.G00.90  Total de l'envoi                        {1,1}

The exact block set carried by THIS declaration nature is the one
listed on the spec sheet; blocks the norm forbids for this nature are
shown there as excluded rather than omitted.

═══ TRANSMISSION AND CHANNEL ═══
Channel  : file_upload - a file generated by the payroll software and
deposited on the portal, or sent machine-to-machine via the
same platform's API.
Portal   : net-entreprises.fr, operated by GIP-MDS.
https://www.net-entreprises.fr/
Deposit  : S10.G00.00.007 = '01 - Net-entreprises'. Value '02 - MSA' is
the agricultural channel and is out of scope for this build.
Test mode: S10.G00.00.005 = '01 - envoi fichier test' routes the file
to the test environment. Conformity is proved with the free
self-check tool before going live; there is no product
certification for France (FR-CCG-001 Module 10.4).
Mandate  : a service provider filing on a client's behalf must be
registered on net-entreprises.fr and hold the client's
mandate. That is a registration, not a software approval.

═══ WHAT CHANGED IN 2026 ═══
The 2026 enumeration of 'Nature de la declaration -
S20.G00.05.001' has SEVEN values:

01  DSN Mensuelle
04  Signalement Arret de travail
05  Signalement Reprise suite a arret de travail
07  Signalement Fin du contrat de travail Unique   <-- this spec
08  Signalement Amorcage des donnees variables
09  DSN de substitution
10  Signalement Declaration prealable a l'embauche

There is NO value 02. The former separate end-of-contract
signal has been replaced by the single FCTU, which carries the
pay history France Travail needs rather than leaving it to be
reconstructed from the monthly filings.

From October 2026 France Travail additionally returns
improvement proposals against a received FCTU as normalised
return message 135 - see FR-URSSAF-002 for the return-flow
mechanics.

═══ WHAT THE SIGNAL DOES NOT DO ═══
Transmitting the FCTU does NOT discharge the employer's duty to
give the departing employee, on the last day of work:

- the France Travail statement, in signed form
- the work certificate (certificat de travail)
- the final settlement statement (recu pour solde de tout compte)

The electronic transmission and the paper hand-over are
COMPLEMENTARY acts. The work certificate and the France Travail
statement may not be withheld pending payment.
```

## Sheet: `Population Rules`

_17 rows x 5 columns._

| Rule Category | Field Name | Source System | Population Logic | Edge Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ═══ MANDATORY FIELD RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Declaration nature | S20.G00.05.001 | Filing component | Must be '07 - Signalement Fin du contrat de travail Unique'. The value '02' used by older references NO LONGER EXISTS in the 2026 enumeration of this rubrique: the seven admitted values are 01, 04, 05, 07, 08, 09 and 10, reproduced verbatim on the Field Options sheet. A filing component still emitting 02 is rejected on deposit. | This is the single change most likely to break a France build carried over from an earlier norm year, because the rejection is at the envelope and reports as a structure error rather than as an unknown nature. |
| Termination reason | S21.G00.62.002 | HR system, mapped to the norm's code list | One of 54 published codes, reproduced on the Field Options sheet. It governs whether and on what terms the employee draws unemployment benefit, so it must be mapped explicitly from the client's own reason list and signed off by the client - never inferred from free text or defaulted to a generic dismissal code. | Value '099 - annulation' is not a termination at all: it suppresses a contract declared in error. Using it to reverse a genuine termination erases the employee's entitlement. |
| End date and last day worked | S21.G00.62.001 and S21.G00.62.008 | Payroll and HR | The contract end date is the last day of the contract; the last day worked and paid at the usual salary can be EARLIER, where notice was not worked. Both are required and they are not interchangeable - France Travail uses the gap between them to establish the deferred start of benefit. | Where notice is worked in full the two dates coincide, which is why the distinction is easy to miss in testing on ordinary cases. |
| ═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Forbidden fields | 78 rubriques of the norm | Filing component | The norm marks 78 rubriques FORBIDDEN in nature 07 and a further 262 as not expected. Populating a forbidden rubrique is a structure rejection, not a warning. Column F of the spec sheet carries the norm's own status for every field, so the signal's field set must be driven from this spec rather than by filtering the monthly one. | The commonest failure is emitting the full monthly field set with the nature changed - it fails immediately, but the error message points at the first forbidden field rather than at the cause. |
| Consistency with the monthly declarations | The pay history blocks | Payroll | The remuneration, bonus, activity and other-gross-element blocks carried by the signal describe periods already declared in monthly DSNs. France Travail reconciles the two, and a divergence produces a non-reconstitution report (compte rendu de non-reconstitution) that the employer must answer. | This is why the pay history must be read from the same stored payroll results that produced the monthly filings, and not recomputed at signal time from current master data - a mid-year salary change would otherwise rewrite history. |
| Notice block | S21.G00.63.001 to .003 | Payroll and HR | Where notice is not worked, the notice start and end dates are still declared, together with the indemnity that would have been paid. Omitting the block because no notice was served is wrong: the notional notice period is what defers the start of benefit. | Waived notice at the employer's initiative and notice not worked at the employee's request have different consequences for the employee and must be distinguished in the source data. |
| ═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Format | All amount and date rubriques in this signal | Payroll | Identical to the monthly declaration: amounts with a full stop and exactly two decimals and no thousands separator, dates as DDMMYYYY with no separators, rates as a percentage with two decimals. The norm's own pattern for each field is reproduced in column J. | There is no signal-specific formatting: a component that formats correctly for the monthly file formats correctly here. |
| ═══ PAYROLL-SPECIFIC POPULATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Sequencing | The signal versus the final payroll run | Payroll calendar | The 5-day deadline usually falls BEFORE the final payroll run that settles the severance and the untaken-leave indemnity. The signal is therefore built from the contract and pay history as they stand at the leaving date, and the final settlement is reported in the monthly DSN for the period in which it is paid. | A process that waits for the final payroll before signalling will miss the deadline for almost every leaver, because French payroll runs are monthly and the deadline is five days. |
| Sector paid-leave funds | Untaken-leave indemnity | Client configuration | In construction, public works, entertainment, dockers and transport, the sector fund pays the employee's holiday pay and the employer pays NO compensatory leave indemnity on termination. A payroll configured on the general regime will compute and report an indemnity that the employer does not owe. | Confirm the client's sector before configuring; see scope_manifest FR-CIBTP-001, which descopes the fund declaration itself but records the mechanism precisely so it is not missed here. |
| ═══ CROSS-FIELD VALIDATIONS ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.40.001 (contract start) <-> S21.G00.62.001 (contract end) | HR and payroll | Control CCH-13 requires the contract start date to be less than or equal to the end date declared in the end-of-contract block, EXCEPT where the termination reason is '099 - annulation'. The exception exists because an annulled contract may never have run at all, so the ordinary ordering test cannot apply to it. | The start date also has to be strictly later than the employee's date of birth (control CCH-15) - a check that catches transposed date components. |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.62.002 (termination reason) <-> the notice and CSP rubriques | HR and payroll | Several rubriques in the end-of-contract block are conditional on the termination reason: the mutually-agreed termination signature date, the date the dismissal procedure was started, and the notice months used in the CSP calculation each apply only to their own reason codes. Each names the reason field in its Conditional Reason, and the reason field carries the back-references. | Populating a reason-specific field under the wrong reason is accepted by some receiving bodies and rejected by others, so it surfaces late and inconsistently. |

## Sheet: `Example Analysis`

_19 rows x 4 columns._

**DSN Signalement Fin du Contrat de Travail Unique (FCTU) — EXAMPLE FILE ANALYSIS**

| Raw Value | Field Name | Interpretation | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| ═══ SIGNAL ENVELOPE ═══ |  |  |  |
| S20.G00.05.001,'07' | Nature de la declaration (S20.G00.05.001) | '07 - Signalement Fin du contrat de travail Unique'. The FCTU. | NOT '02' - that value no longer exists in the 2026 norm. |
| S20.G00.05.005,'01032026' | Date du mois principal declare | The signal attaches to the March 2026 payroll month. | Even an event signal carries a principal declared month. |
| ═══ WHO IS LEAVING ═══ |  |  |  |
| S21.G00.30.001,'1850175116017' | NIR (S21.G00.30.001) | The departing employee. | Must be the same NIR carried in the monthly filings for this contract, or France Travail cannot reconstitute the pay history. |
| S21.G00.40.009,'CT-2024-000417' | Numero du contrat (S21.G00.40.009) | The contract that is ending. | The join key. Reusing a contract number across two employments of the same person merges them irrecoverably. |
| ═══ THE TERMINATION ═══ |  |  |  |
| S21.G00.62.001,'31032026' | Date de fin du contrat (S21.G00.62.001) | The contract ends on 31 March 2026. | Must be on or after the contract start date, unless the reason is '099 - annulation' (control CCH-13). |
| S21.G00.62.002,'014' | Motif de la rupture du contrat (S21.G00.62.002) | One of the 54 published termination reasons - see the Field Options sheet for the list. | ILLUSTRATIVE code only. The reason determines the employee's unemployment entitlement and must be mapped and signed off per client, never defaulted. |
| S21.G00.62.008,'15032026' | Dernier jour travaille et paye au salaire habituel (S21.G00.62.008) | The employee last worked on 15 March although the contract ran to 31 March - notice was not worked. | The gap between this and the end date is what defers the start of benefit. |
| ═══ NOTICE ═══ |  |  |  |
| S21.G00.63.001,'16032026' | Date de debut de preavis | Notice ran from 16 March. | Declared even where the notice was not actually worked. |
| S21.G00.63.002,'31032026' | Date de fin de preavis | Notice ended with the contract. | The notional notice period still has to be reported. |
| ═══ PAY HISTORY TRAVELLING WITH THE SIGNAL ═══ |  |  |  |
| S21.G00.51.011,'001' | Type de remuneration (S21.G00.51.011) | The remuneration component type, from the norm's code list. | This is what makes the signal 'unique': the pay history travels with it rather than being reconstructed. |
| S21.G00.51.013,'3200.00' | Montant (S21.G00.51.013) | A monthly remuneration component of 3,200.00 euro. | Must agree with what was declared in the monthly DSN for the same period, or a non-reconstitution report follows. |

## Sheet: `Payroll Scope Summary`

_35 rows x 3 columns._

**DSN Signalement Arret de travail et Signalement Reprise suite a arret de travail — PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY**

**Who is signalled when work stops and when it resumes, what the employer declares, and - the point that governs French sickness payroll - who receives the daily benefits. The employer declares facts and dates only: there is not one amount rubrique in either signal. The money comes back separately, as the BPIJ return FR-CPAM-003.**

| ITEM / SCENARIO | IN SCOPE? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|
| ═══ WHO GETS REPORTED ═══ |  |  |
| An employee absent through ordinary sickness | YES | Reason '01 - maladie'. The commonest case and the one that drives the waiting-period and top-up configuration. |
| An employee on maternity, paternity or adoption leave | YES | Reasons 02, 03 and 09. These carry no waiting period and are paid from the first day, unlike ordinary sickness. |
| An employee absent after a work accident, a commuting accident or an occupational disease | YES | Reasons 04, 05 and 06. The signal is still due - but it does NOT replace the separate accident declaration to the fund (FR-CPAM-002), which is due within 48 hours and is a different obligation with a different clock. |
| A pregnant employee excused from work | YES | Reason '07 - femme enceinte dispensee de travail'. |
| An employee returning on a part-time therapeutic basis | YES | Reason '15 - temps partiel therapeutique' for the stoppage, and resumption reason '02 - reprise temps partiel therapeutique'. The part-time therapeutic return is paid partly by the employer and partly by the fund, so it must be signalled and not treated as an ordinary return. |
| An employee whose contract is suspended for a reason that is not a medical stoppage | NO | Unpaid leave, sabbatical, parental leave taken after the paid period, strike and lay-off are absences carried in the monthly DSN's activity blocks, not stoppage signals. Only a medically prescribed stoppage opens a daily-benefit entitlement. |
| Public-service stoppage reasons (codes 10 to 14) | NO | The reason list carries five [FP] public-service values - long-term sickness leave, long-duration leave and the rest. They are shown on the Field Options sheet because the norm publishes them, but they are out of scope for this build per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt. Value '13' is additionally applicable to the electricity and gas industries scheme, also out of scope. |
| Employees of the agricultural scheme (MSA) | NO | Separate collection network and separate deposit channel. Descoped as FR-MSA-001. |
| Public-service employees (fonction publique) | NO | Out of scope per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt. The norm's [FP] rubriques are shown on the spec sheet as excluded. |
| Employees under a regime special (RATP, ENIM, CNIEG, CRPCEN, CNBF, CAVIMAC) | NO | Out of scope per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt, which locks this build to the regime general. |
| ═══ WHAT GETS REPORTED ═══ |  |  |
| The reason for the stoppage | YES | One of the norm's codes. It determines the waiting period, the benefit rate and whether the absence counts against the employer's occupational-risk record. |
| The last day actually worked | YES | Normally the day before the prescription starts - but the norm states two exceptions in terms: where the stoppage is prescribed on a day that was worked, the last day worked IS the date of the stoppage. Getting this wrong shifts the whole waiting period. |
| The forecast end date of the stoppage | YES | The date the doctor prescribed. The norm requires it even where the employee does not in fact return on it. |
| Whether the employer is subrogated, and for what period | YES | In the stoppage signal only. Subrogation decides whether the daily benefits are paid to the employer or to the employee. |
| The employer's IBAN and BIC | YES | Conditional on subrogation: the account the fund pays the benefits into. It is the EMPLOYER's account, not the employee's. |
| The actual date of return, and how work resumed | YES | In the resumption signal, where both are mandatory. In the stoppage signal they are conditional - populated where the return is already known when the signal is built. |
| The amount of the daily benefits | NO | The employer does not compute the benefits and does not declare them here. The fund computes them from the pay history already held and reports what it paid in the BPIJ return, FR-CPAM-003. |
| The employer's salary top-up (maintien de salaire) | NO | A payroll amount governed by the Labour Code minimum and by the applicable collective agreement. It is paid on the payslip and reported in the monthly DSN, not in this signal. |
| ═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══ |  |  |
| Filed within 5 days of the employer learning of the stoppage | YES | Of LEARNING of it. An employee who posts a medical certificate late starts the employer's clock late, which is why the received date must be recorded and not assumed to be the prescription date. |
| The stoppage is also reported in the monthly DSN | YES | As an activity or suspension period, together with any subrogated benefits received and any employer top-up paid. The signal does not replace the monthly filing. |
| The signal discharges the work-accident declaration | NO | It does not. A work accident must additionally be declared to the fund within 48 hours (FR-CPAM-002). The two obligations have different deadlines, different channels and different consequences for failure. |
| A resumption signal is needed where the employee returns on the forecast date | PARTIAL | The norm's requirement bites where the return is EARLIER than the forecast end date carried in the stoppage signal, and for a part-time therapeutic return. Clients differ on whether they signal every return; confirm the client's rule and apply it consistently, because an unsignalled early return leaves the fund paying benefits for days the employee worked. |
| ═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══ |  |  |
| An employee with several employers | YES | Each employer signals its own stoppage for its own contract. Subrogation is per employer, so one employer may be subrogated and another not for the same absence. |
| A stoppage that runs across a contract end | YES | The stoppage is signalled by the employer for the period of the contract. What happens after the contract ends is between the employee and the fund, and the end of contract is signalled separately as FR-DSN-002. |
| An extension of an existing stoppage (prolongation) | YES | Signalled as a stoppage with the same reason and the new forecast end date. It is not a new absence and must not restart the waiting period. |
| Several establishments grouped for benefit payment | YES | Where a subrogated employer centralises benefit payment across establishments, the centralising establishment's SIRET is carried in S21.G00.60.600. Without it the fund pays each establishment separately, which breaks the client's reconciliation. |

En contrepartie, l'employeur doit maintenir le salaire à hauteur des indemnités reçues. A noter que la subrogation peut également s'appliquer aux indemnités journalières versées dans le cadre d'un temps partiel thérapeutique. »<br><br>SUBROGATION IS THE HINGE OF THE WHOLE FRENCH SICKNESS PROCESS. Where the employer is subrogated, the sickness fund pays the daily benefits to the EMPLOYER, and the employer maintains the employee's salary. Where it is not, the fund pays the EMPLOYEE directly and the employer pays only its own top-up, computed net of the benefits the employee receives. The same absence therefore produces two completely different payslips depending on this one flag, and the flag is declared here rather than derived by payroll. | Yes - payroll master data, supplied to the filing from employee or employer records | Field Options: S21.G00.60.004 (2 values) | Not applicable - not a numeric field. | N | Code - Input | Per Signalement Arret de travail | Confirm per client, and if the client's practice varies by collective agreement or by category, per population: is the employer subrogated?
