## Sheet: `Sample File`

_31 rows x 1 columns._

```text
Compte rendu metier URSSAF (retour organisme normalise NEOReS) - inbound — SAMPLE FILE
OMITTED - see below. No official specimen return exists in FR-compliance/00-official-sources/sample-files/, and this workbook will not fabricate one. The reason is specific rather than general: a fabricated XML instance for a flow that HAS a published XSD is worse than no sample, because it looks authoritative and will be used to build a parser. The verified facts about the file are stated on the File Structure sheet - XML, validated against the published XSD with the CRM-Val validator, block and rubrique names transmitted with UNDERSCORES rather than dots, '<', '>' and '&' forbidden inside values, one attachment flow per transmission. Those are what a parser must be built against. The Example Analysis sheet parses individual values field by field, in the transmitted underscore form, and marks every invented value as illustrative. To obtain a real instance: retrieve a CRM from a live client's DSN dashboard on net-entreprises.fr, or request the XSD and the CRM-Val validator from GIP-MDS.

SAMPLE FILE DELIBERATELY NOT PROVIDED.

This flow has an OFFICIAL XSD. A fabricated XML instance would be used
to build a parser and would encode this workbook's guesses about
element nesting as though they were the schema. That is a worse
outcome than an absent sample, so none is given.

What IS verified, and is on the File Structure sheet:

- the return is XML, not flat text (unlike the outbound DSN);
- it is validated against the XSD published for the norm version
named in RO.R001, using the CRM-Val validator;
- block and rubrique names arrive with UNDERSCORES, not dots:
the norm documents RO.B004.R003 and transmits RO_B004_R003;
- the characters '<', '>' and '&' are forbidden inside values;
- one transmission carries exactly ONE attachment flow, and
therefore one DSN and one declared establishment;
- six rubriques carry up to 3,000 characters and one up to 10,000.

To obtain a real instance:
1. retrieve a CRM from a live client's DSN dashboard on
net-entreprises.fr; or
2. request the XSD and the CRM-Val validator from GIP-MDS.

When one is obtained, this sheet should be replaced and the workbook
re-versioned. Until then the Example Analysis sheet parses individual
values field by field, in the transmitted underscore form, with every
invented value marked ILLUSTRATIVE.
```

## Sheet: `Payroll Scope Summary`

_29 rows x 3 columns._

**Declaration obligatoire d'emploi des travailleurs handicapes (DOETH) - carried in the April DSN — PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY**

**Who owes the disabled-worker employment obligation, who counts towards it, and how the annual contribution is declared. The governing fact for a payroll build is one of sequencing: the April return is CONSOLIDATED FROM THE TWELVE MONTHLY DSNs already deposited, so a status never declared during the year cannot be added in April, and the year's data must be corrected before the April run rather than after it.**

| ITEM / SCENARIO | IN SCOPE? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|
| ═══ WHO OWES THE OBLIGATION ═══ |  |  |
| An employer of 20 or more employees, counted at legal-entity level | YES | Labour Code art. L5212-1: the obligation bites at 20 employees, and since the 2020 reform it is assessed on the ENTERPRISE, not on each establishment. A group of small establishments that together reach 20 is inside the obligation even though no single establishment is. |
| An employer below 20 employees | NO | No contribution is owed. But the per-employee disabled-worker status is still declared in the monthly DSN, because the headcount is measured from the declarations themselves and because crossing the threshold must be visible when it happens. |
| An employer that has just crossed the 20-employee threshold | PARTIAL | The Social Security Code headcount rules give a moratorium on newly-crossed thresholds. Whether it applies, and for how long, is a client-specific determination that must be checked against the current rule rather than assumed - the moratorium regime has been amended more than once. |
| An employer covered by an approved agreement (accord agree) | YES | It still declares. But the contribution is replaced by the spend committed under the agreement, the agreement reference is carried in S21.G00.13.001, and any committed spend NOT actually incurred comes back as a declared amount under code 069. |
| Public-service employers | NO | They have a parallel obligation with its own fund and its own return. Out of scope per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt. The status code list nonetheless carries two public-service values (10 and 11), shown on the Field Options sheet because the norm publishes them. |
| ═══ WHO COUNTS TOWARDS THE QUOTA ═══ |  |  |
| An employee holding one of the twelve recognised statuses | YES | The norm's list runs from formal recognition by the disability rights commission through occupational-injury pensioners, invalidity pensioners, war-pension beneficiaries, inclusion-mobility card holders and disabled-adult allowance recipients. It is a legal list, not a medical judgement, and the employer records the status the employee evidences. |
| Disabled workers made available by a third party | YES | Agency workers, employees of an employer grouping, of an intermediary association, of a modelling agency, of a shared-time employment business. Counted through S21.G00.13.002 and .003 - as a NUMBER, because these people are not on the declaring employer's payroll and cannot be declared per person. |
| Disabled trainees hosted during the year | PARTIAL | Yes, but the norm is explicit about which route: where they were already declared per person in the monthly DSNs they must NOT be declared again in the annual block. Declaring them twice inflates the count and understates the contribution. |
| A disabled worker employed by a subcontractor | NO | Not counted as employment. But spending with sheltered-sector suppliers is DEDUCTIBLE from the contribution under code 061, which is a different mechanism with a different evidential basis. |
| ═══ WHAT GETS DECLARED ═══ |  |  |
| The per-employee disabled-worker status, every month | YES | S21.G00.40.072, in every monthly DSN. The annual return is built from these, so a status never declared monthly cannot appear in April. |
| A change of status, or a retroactive correction | YES | S21.G00.41.048 carries the PREVIOUS status, including the value '99 - absence de statut BOETH' where someone previously declared no longer qualifies. |
| The approved agreement reference | YES | S21.G00.13.001, validated against the authority's own table of approved agreements. It is not free text. |
| The gross contribution, the deductions and the net | YES | S21.G00.82 under codes 065, 060 to 064 and 071 to 073, and 066. The norm requires the gross and the net to be declared TOGETHER. |
| The real contribution due | YES | Code 068, which must be paired with the gross contribution under control CCH-24. |
| The headcount and the number of units owed | NO | Not declared as such. URSSAF computes the headcount from the declarations it already holds - which is precisely why the monthly data must be right before April, and why a correction after the April filing is a correction of the assessment, not of a form. |
| The nature of an employee's disability | NO | NEVER. The status code identifies the legal category that qualifies the person, not their condition. Nothing in this return asks what is wrong with anybody, and a build that stores more than the code is collecting special-category data it has no basis for. |
| ═══ TIMING AND SPECIAL CASES ═══ |  |  |
| Assessed and declared in April of the following year | YES | Filed on the ordinary DSN deadline, 5 or 15 May. The reference period is the closed calendar year. |
| Corrections to the year's data must be made before April | YES | This is the practical rule that governs the whole filing. The April return consolidates twelve monthly flows; correcting a status in June means correcting an assessment that has already been struck. |
| The contribution can be reduced by documented expenditure | YES | Codes 060 to 064 and 071 to 073: subcontracting with the sheltered sector, accessibility works, retention and redeployment, support and awareness services, events, association partnerships, and professionalisation actions. Each needs evidence held outside payroll. |
| The escrement (capping) code is still usable | PARTIAL | Code 067 exists but the norm restricts it to reference years STRICTLY BEFORE 2025. It is available for correcting old years and must not be used for the current one - which is exactly the sort of code a build carried over from an earlier year keeps emitting. |

Mandatory in declaration nature '01 - DSN Mensuelle'.<br><br>Norm definition, CT2026.1.2, quoted verbatim: « L'établissement est une unité de production localisée géographiquement, individualisée mais dépendant juridiquement d'une entreprise. Dans le cadre d'un contrat de travail, il s'agit de l'établissement de rattachement administratif du salarié. Persistence differs from the SIREN - a relocation issues a new NIC while the SIREN is unchanged, and the DSN must then be filed under the new SIRET with a change block.<br><br>Composite Key Structure. SIRET(14) = SIREN(9) + NIC(5). The SIREN identifies the legal entity and is stable across a change of payroll provider; the NIC identifies the establishment within it and CHANGES when the establishment moves or closes. Both carry a Luhn check digit. Sub-field source: INSEE SIRENE register. Persistence: SIREN for the life of the entity, NIC per establishment. A 2-digit control key, 97 minus (the 13-digit number modulo 97), is held alongside it for capture validation but is NOT transmitted in this rubrique. Sub-field source: INSEE RNIPP. Persistence: allocated once for life and never reissued. ## Sheet: `File Structure`

_145 rows x 1 columns._

```text
Declaration obligatoire d'emploi des travailleurs handicapes (DOETH) - carried in the April DSN — FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

═══ FILE FORMAT ═══
Norm            : NEODeS, cahier technique CT2026.1.2 (P26V01,
revision 20251224, release 2026.1.0.9).
Physical form   : a flat text file, one rubrique per record. The norm
states the record layout as  [Sxx.Gyy.zz.aaa,'value']
and gives as its own example:
S21.G00.06.001,'332975200'
There is no XML, no XSD and no fixed-width layout.
A build that assumes XML here is wrong.
Field separator : the comma, hex 2C.
Value delimiter : the apostrophe, hex 27, on both sides of the value.
Record delimiter: CR-LF (hex 0D0A) or LF (hex 0A) alone. Both accepted.
Encoding        : ISO/IEC 8859-1 (E), alphabet Latin-1. Named by the norm
as THE usable character table - not UTF-8.
Extension       : .txt (also accepted inside a .zip for bulk deposit).
Record length   : variable, maximum 256 ASCII characters per record.
The per-value length constraint is the rubrique's own,
from its data type.
(cahier technique CT2026.1.2, section 3, p.77)
Declaration     : nature '01 - DSN Mensuelle'
carried in S20.G00.05.001.

═══ STRUCTURAL HIERARCHY ═══
The file is a strict nesting of blocks. A child block may only appear
inside its parent, and the cardinality shown is the norm's own.

S10.G00.00  Envoi                                   {1,1}
S10.G00.01  Emetteur                              {1,1}
S10.G00.02  Contact Emetteur                      {1,1}
S20.G00.05  Declaration                           {1,*}
S21.G00.06  Entreprise                          {1,1}
S21.G00.11  Etablissement                     {1,*}
S21.G00.30  Individu                        {0,*}
S21.G00.40  Contrat                       {1,*}
S21.G00.50  Versement individu          {1,*}
S21.G00.51  Remuneration              {0,*}
S21.G00.78  Base assujettie           {0,*}
S21.G00.81  Cotisation individuelle {0,*}
S21.G00.22  Bordereau de cotisation due     {0,*}
S21.G00.23  Cotisation agregee            {0,*}
S21.G00.20  Versement organisme             {0,*}
S90.G00.90  Total de l'envoi                        {1,1}

The exact block set carried by THIS declaration nature is the one
listed on the spec sheet; blocks the norm forbids for this nature are
shown there as excluded rather than omitted.

═══ TRANSMISSION AND CHANNEL ═══
Channel  : file_upload - a file generated by the payroll software and
deposited on the portal, or sent machine-to-machine via the
same platform's API.
Portal   : net-entreprises.fr, operated by GIP-MDS.
https://www.net-entreprises.fr/
Deposit  : S10.G00.00.007 = '01 - Net-entreprises'. Value '02 - MSA' is
the agricultural channel and is out of scope for this build.
Test mode: S10.G00.00.005 = '01 - envoi fichier test' routes the file
to the test environment. Conformity is proved with the free
self-check tool before going live; there is no product
certification for France (FR-CCG-001 Module 10.4).
Mandate  : a service provider filing on a client's behalf must be
registered on net-entreprises.fr and hold the client's
mandate. That is a registration, not a software approval.

═══ WHERE THE DOETH ACTUALLY LIVES ═══
There is no DOETH form. Since the 2020 reform the return is a set
of DSN blocks, and the annual assessment rides the April DSN.

MONTHLY, in every FR-DSN-001
S21.G00.40.072  Statut BOETH        per employee, per contract
S21.G00.41.048  Ancien statut BOETH change or correction

ANNUALLY, in the APRIL DSN only
S21.G00.13      Complement OETH
.001  approved agreement reference (table AAETH)
.002  type of externally-provided disabled worker
.003  number of them, FRACTIONAL
.004  reference year

S21.G00.82      Cotisation etablissement, codes:
060  ECAP deduction
061  sheltered-sector subcontracting deduction
062  accessibility works
063  retention and redeployment
064  support and awareness services
065  GROSS contribution before deductions
066  NET contribution
067  net after capping - PRE-2025 YEARS ONLY
068  REAL contribution due
069  agreement spend committed and not incurred
071  participation in events
072  partnerships with associations
073  professionalisation actions and sheltered purchases

The assessment itself - the headcount, the units owed - is NOT
declared. URSSAF computes it from the declarations it already
holds. That is why the monthly data must be right before April.

═══ THE THREE PAIRING CONTROLS ═══
The norm does not recompute the OETH arithmetic. It enforces the
shape of the declaration through three controls, all quoted on the
Population Rules sheet:

CCH-21   for codes 060-069 and 071-073, the START YEAR and the
END YEAR of the attachment period must be IDENTICAL.
The norm's stated purpose: to forbid declarations that
straddle two annual exercises.

CCH-22   065 requires 066 with the same period, and 066 requires
065 with the same period. Bidirectional in the norm's
own wording.

CCH-24   065 requires 068 with the same period, and 068 requires
065 with the same period. Also bidirectional.

Together these fix the minimum shape of a compliant assessment:
AT LEAST THREE S21.G00.82 BLOCKS - 065, 066 and 068 - all sharing
one attachment period covering the closed reference year, plus one
further block per deduction claimed.

Two practical consequences:
- A component that emits one contribution block per code in a
loop can satisfy the codes and still fail the pairing, because
the pairing is between BLOCKS, not between rubriques.
- A component that defaults the attachment period to the declared
month - which is correct for ordinary monthly contributions -
emits April-to-April and is rejected by CCH-21.

═══ WHAT THIS RETURN IS NOT ═══
NOT a workforce census. It asks for a legal status code and a
count. It does not ask, and must not be used to collect, anything
about anybody's condition.

NOT an HR-scope filing. The v2.5 HR-scope filter (C1) descopes
annual workforce censuses requiring headcount by qualification,
occupation, nationality or gender. This filing is in scope because
its inputs are payroll-borne: a per-employee status carried in the
monthly DSN and a contribution computed on it. The one input that
is NOT payroll-borne - the count of third-party disabled workers in
S21.G00.13.003 - is called out here and on the Population Rules
sheet precisely so it is sourced deliberately rather than guessed.

NOT the gender-equality index (Egapro), which IS descoped, as
FR-HR-001 in scope_manifest.authority_filings.out_of_scope.
```

## Sheet: `Population Rules`

_21 rows x 5 columns._

| Rule Category | Field Name | Source System | Population Logic | Edge Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ═══ MANDATORY FIELD RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| The per-employee status drives everything | S21.G00.40.072 | HR, under a documented GDPR art. 9 lawful basis | Declared in EVERY monthly DSN for every employee who holds one of the twelve recognised statuses, for the contract concerned and for the declared period. The annual assessment is computed by URSSAF from these monthly declarations, so the April return cannot add anyone who was not declared during the year. The engine must therefore treat this as ordinary monthly master data with an effective-dated history, not as an annual attribute gathered at assessment time. | It is special-category personal data. Restrict access, define retention, and do not propagate it to reports that do not need it. Also handle expiry: several of the qualifying statuses are time-limited, and a lapsed recognition that keeps being declared overstates the count and understates the contribution. |
| A change of status carries the OLD value | S21.G00.41.048 | HR | Where a previously declared status changes - whether prospectively or as a retroactive correction - the change block carries the PREVIOUS status, not the new one. The new status goes in S21.G00.40.072 as usual. The list for the change rubrique carries one extra value the ordinary list does not: '99 - Absence de statut BOETH', which is how the declaration says that someone previously counted no longer qualifies. | Without value 99 there would be no way to withdraw a status, and simply dropping the rubrique from the monthly declaration does not withdraw it - it leaves the earlier declarations standing. |
| The reference year | S21.G00.13.004 and S21.G00.82.003 / .004 | Filing component | The annual complement block carries the year it is subscribed for, and the contribution block carries an attachment period. Control CCH-21 requires the START AND END YEARS OF THE ATTACHMENT PERIOD TO BE IDENTICAL for every OETH code (060 to 069, 071 to 073). The control exists, in the norm's own words, to forbid declarations that straddle two annual exercises. | A component that defaults the attachment period to the declared month - as it correctly does for ordinary monthly contributions - will emit an April-to-April period and be rejected. The OETH period is the closed reference YEAR. |
| ═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| The gross and net contribution must be declared together | S21.G00.82.002 codes 065 and 066 | Filing component | Control CCH-22 is bidirectional and the norm states it in both directions: if a contribution block carries '065 - Contribution OETH brute avant deductions', then another block with the SAME attachment period must carry '066 - Contribution OETH nette'; and conversely, if one carries 066 then another with the same period must carry 065. Neither may be declared alone. | The purpose is to make the deduction chain auditable: the reader can always see what was owed before deductions and what was owed after. A build that declares only the net figure - the only one the employer actually pays - is rejected. |
| The gross contribution and the real contribution due must be declared together | S21.G00.82.002 codes 065 and 068 | Filing component | Control CCH-24, also bidirectional in the norm's own wording: 065 requires 068 with the same period, and 068 requires 065 with the same period. Together with CCH-22 this means a compliant OETH assessment carries AT LEAST three contribution blocks - 065, 066 and 068 - all sharing one attachment period. | 065, 066 and 068 are three different numbers answering three different questions: what the quota shortfall costs before anything is set against it, what it costs after deductions, and what is actually payable. Treating them as one figure repeated three times defeats the point of the controls. |
| The capping code is closed for current years | S21.G00.82.002 code 067 | Filing component | '067 - Contribution OETH nette apres ecretement' is restricted by the norm to reference years STRICTLY BEFORE 2025. It remains available so that old years can be corrected. Emitting it for 2025 or later is wrong. | This is a classic carry-over defect: a build configured against an earlier norm year keeps emitting a code that is now historical, and because the code still exists it does not fail as an unknown value. |
| Deductible expenditure is evidenced, not asserted | S21.G00.82.002 codes 060 to 064, 071 to 073 | Client records outside payroll | Each deduction code covers a distinct category defined by the Labour Code and by ministerial order - the ECAP deduction, subcontracting with sheltered-sector suppliers, accessibility works, retention and redeployment, support and awareness services, participation in events, partnerships with associations, and professionalisation actions with purchases from the sheltered sector. None of these amounts originates in payroll. Each must be computed by whoever holds the evidence and passed to the filing with an audit trail. | The risk is not a rejection - the file accepts whatever amount is supplied. The risk is an unsupported deduction found on inspection, years later, with the interest that follows. Payroll should not be the system of record for any of these figures. |
| ═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Amounts and counts in the same block set | S21.G00.82.001 against S21.G00.13.003 | Filing component | The contribution block carries signed amounts with two decimals, zero permitted, per the norm's own pattern in column J. The annual complement block carries a COUNT of externally-provided disabled workers - which the norm nonetheless types as a decimal number, because a person made available for part of a year counts fractionally. Do not truncate it to an integer. | The fractional count is the point most often missed: an agency worker present for three months is not one unit and is not zero. |
| ═══ PAYROLL-SPECIFIC POPULATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Sequencing - the April return is a consolidation, not a collection | The whole filing | The twelve monthly DSNs of the reference year | Build the annual assessment by reading the year's already-deposited monthly declarations, not by re-querying current master data. An employee who held the status for four months and left in July counts for those four months; current master data no longer knows them. The engine must therefore hold the monthly declared history and assess from it. A December-to-April reconciliation step should exist and should be run BEFORE the April payroll closes. | FR-CCG-001 Module 10 records this as a year-end task with an April deadline for exactly this reason. A correction discovered in June is a correction to an assessment already struck, which is a materially harder conversation with URSSAF than a correction made in March. |
| Third-party disabled workers do not come from payroll | S21.G00.13.002 and .003 | Procurement, HR or the agency's own statement | Agency workers, employees of an employer grouping, of an intermediary association, of a modelling agency, of a shared-time employment business. They count towards the client's obligation but they are on somebody else's payroll. The number must be obtained from whoever manages those relationships, with the fractional presence computed on the same basis the Labour Code uses. | The norm adds a trap here: disabled TRAINEES already declared per person in the monthly DSNs must NOT be re-declared in this block. A process that collects 'everyone who counted' from HR and adds it to what payroll already declared double-counts them. |
| Data protection | S21.G00.40.072 and S21.G00.41.048 | Payroll and HR jointly | Both rubriques carry special-category personal data within the meaning of GDPR art. 9. Declaring them is lawful - the Labour Code requires it - but everything around them is a design decision: who can see the field in the payroll UI, whether it appears on internal reports, whether it is exported to test environments, how long it is retained after the employee leaves, and whether the audit trail of changes is itself protected. | Test data is the usual leak: a production extract used to seed a test system carries real disability statuses for real people. Mask this field in any non-production copy. |
| ═══ CROSS-FIELD VALIDATIONS ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.82.002 code 065 <-> code 066 (CCH-22) | Filing component | Stated by the norm in both directions and quoted above: neither the gross nor the net OETH contribution may be declared without the other, and both must carry the same attachment period. Each side names the other in its Conditional Reason. | Because the two blocks are separate S21.G00.82 occurrences rather than two rubriques of one block, a component that builds contribution blocks in a loop can easily emit one and not the other. |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.82.002 code 065 <-> code 068 (CCH-24) | Filing component | Also stated in both directions: the gross contribution requires the real contribution due, and the real contribution due requires the gross. With CCH-22 this fixes the minimum shape of a compliant assessment at three paired blocks sharing one period. | The three figures are genuinely different. If a build produces three identical amounts, the deductions have not been applied and the client is over-paying. |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.13.001 (approved agreement) <-> S21.G00.82.002 code 069 | Client governance | Code '069 - Depenses OETH prevues par l'accord et non realisees' exists only for employers covered by an approved agreement. Where an agreement reference is declared, the committed spend that was not in fact incurred has to be reported under 069; where no agreement is declared, 069 has no meaning. | This is the mechanism that stops an approved agreement from being a way of avoiding the contribution: whatever was promised and not spent comes back. Clients under an agreement need a spend-tracking process that closes in time for the April filing. |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.40.072 (current status) <-> S21.G00.41.048 (previous status) | HR | The change rubrique is conditional on there having been a previously declared status for the same individual and contract. It carries the OLD value; the new value stays in S21.G00.40.072. Value '99 - Absence de statut BOETH' in the change rubrique is how a status is withdrawn. | Dropping S21.G00.40.072 from the monthly declaration does NOT withdraw a status - it leaves every earlier declaration standing and the assessment computed on them. |

| S21.G00.41.048,'99' | Ancien statut BOETH (S21.G00.41.048) | '99 - Absence de statut BOETH'. This employee previously held no status; the change block records what it was before. | The change rubrique carries the OLD value. Value 99 is how a status is withdrawn or how a first grant is recorded - it does not exist in the current-status list. |
| ═══ THE ANNUAL COMPLEMENT - APRIL DSN ONLY ═══ |  |  |  |
| S21.G00.13.004,'2025' | Millesime de rattachement (S21.G00.13.004) | The block is subscribed for reference year 2025, in the April 2026 DSN. | The assessment always looks back at a closed calendar year. |
| S21.G00.13.002,'01' | Type BOETH externe (S21.G00.13.002) | '01 - BOETH interimaires'. Disabled agency workers made available to this company during the year. | These people are on the agency's payroll, not the client's. The number cannot come from a payroll extract. |
| S21.G00.13.003,'2.50' | Nombre BOETH externe (S21.G00.13.003) | Two and a half units - fractional, because presence during part of a year counts proportionally. | ILLUSTRATIVE value. Do not truncate to an integer: an agency worker present for six months is half a unit, not one and not zero. |
| ═══ THE ASSESSMENT - THREE PAIRED BLOCKS, ONE PERIOD ═══ |  |  |  |
| S21.G00.82.002,'065'  S21.G00.82.001,'18400.00' | Contribution OETH brute avant deductions | What the quota shortfall costs before anything is set against it. | ILLUSTRATIVE amount. Control CCH-22 makes code 066 compulsory alongside it, and CCH-24 makes code 068 compulsory too - all three with the same attachment period. |
| S21.G00.82.002,'061'  S21.G00.82.001,'-3200.00' | Deduction de sous-traitance (EA, ESAT, TIH, portage salarial) | Spending with sheltered-sector suppliers, set against the contribution. | ILLUSTRATIVE amount. Evidenced from procurement records, not from payroll. An unsupported deduction is found on inspection, not on deposit. |
| S21.G00.82.002,'066'  S21.G00.82.001,'15200.00' | Contribution OETH nette | The contribution after the deductions have been applied. | Must share the attachment period with 065 and 068. |
| S21.G00.82.002,'068'  S21.G00.82.001,'15200.00' | Contribution OETH reelle due | What is actually payable for the year. | Equal to the net figure here, but they are different questions and can differ. Three identical amounts usually means the deductions were never applied. |
| S21.G00.82.003,'01012025'  S21.G00.82.004,'31122025' | Periode de rattachement (S21.G00.82.003 / .004) | The closed reference year, 1 January to 31 December 2025. | Control CCH-21 requires the two YEARS to be identical. Defaulting the period to the declared month - correct for ordinary monthly contributions - is rejected here. |

## Sheet: `Payroll Scope Summary`

_32 rows x 3 columns._

**Solde de la taxe d'apprentissage et assujettissements fiscaux - carried in the April DSN — PAYROLL SCOPE SUMMARY**

**How the apprenticeship tax is declared, and why only part of it appears here. The 0.59 % principal is a monthly contribution like any other; the 0.09 % balance is annual, computed on the CLOSED PRECEDING year's payroll and declared in the April DSN. The same block also carries the employer's liability position on four other levies, including the payroll tax whose return is filed on a different portal entirely.**

| ITEM / SCENARIO | IN SCOPE? | NOTES / REASONING |
|---|---|---|
| ═══ WHO OWES THE TAX ═══ |  |  |
| A commercial employer subject to French corporate or income tax | YES | The ordinary case. Liability is declared positively in S21.G00.44.001 under code '001 - Assujettissement a la taxe a l'apprentissage'. |
| An employer exempt from the apprenticeship tax | YES | It still declares - under code '002 - Non assujettissement', with the exemption ground in S21.G00.44.004 taken from the authority's MNATA table. Silence is not a declaration of exemption. |
| An employer of apprentices whose payroll is below six times the minimum wage | YES | Exempt, and the exemption is declared positively through contribution code '074 - Exoneration Taxe d'apprentissage pour un employeur d'apprenti(s), dont la masse salariale est inferieure a 6 SMICs'. |
| An employer of 250 or more with too few work-study contracts | YES | Additionally liable to the supplementary apprenticeship contribution (CSA), declared under S21.G00.44.001 code 003 and contribution code 079. The trigger is a HEADCOUNT RATIO, not a payroll amount. |
| An employer in Alsace-Moselle | YES | At the reduced total rate of 0.44 % rather than 0.68 % (FR-CCG-001 Module 6). The local regime is a rate difference, not an exemption, and it is establishment-based - a client with establishments on both sides of the boundary needs both. |
| Public-service employers | NO | Outside the apprenticeship tax and outside this build per shared/FR_regime_scope_note.txt. |
| Agricultural-scheme employers (MSA) | NO | Separate collection network and separate channel. Descoped as FR-MSA-001. |
| ═══ WHAT GETS DECLARED ═══ |  |  |
| The employer's liability position on five separate levies | YES | S21.G00.44.001, as fourteen paired liable / not-liable codes covering the apprenticeship tax, the supplementary apprenticeship contribution, the construction-effort levy, the vocational-training contribution and the payroll tax. |
| The base the employer self-assesses | YES | S21.G00.44.002. The norm calls it auto-liquidation in terms: the employer computes it, declares it, and nothing recomputes it. |
| The reference year | YES | S21.G00.44.003 and the S21.G00.82 attachment period - the CLOSED PRECEDING calendar year, not the declared month. |
| The balance paid in cash | YES | Contribution code '076 - Solde de la taxe d'apprentissage verse en numeraire'. |
| Reductions against the balance | YES | Codes 075, 077 and 078: deductions for company training centres and for financing new apprenticeship provision (Labour Code art. L6241-2), reductions for grants in kind to training centres and for work-study receivables (art. L6241-4). The norm cites the articles in the code labels themselves. |
| The supplementary apprenticeship contribution, or its exemption | YES | Codes 079 and 080. |
| Which training institutions the balance should fund | NO | Not here. That is the SOLTeA allocation, a separate act on a separate platform after the money is paid - specified as FR-CDC-001. It is a client decision, not a payroll one, and where the employer makes no allocation a default distribution rule applies. |
| The payroll tax return itself | NO | Only the LIABILITY is declared here, through codes 009, 010, 015 and 016. The return is form 2501-SD / 2502-SD, filed on impots.gouv.fr as FR-DGFIP-003. Two declarations of one fact, on two portals, which must agree. |
| ═══ TIMING AND RELATIONSHIP ═══ |  |  |
| The balance is computed on the closed preceding year | YES | April 2026 declares reference year 2025. This is what makes the attachment period an annual one and not the declared month. |
| The principal part is collected monthly | YES | 0.59 % of the 0.68 %, as an ordinary monthly contribution in FR-DSN-001. Only the 0.09 % balance is annual. Treating the whole tax as annual under-collects for eleven months and over-collects in the twelfth. |
| The balance is declared in the same block as the disabled-worker contribution | YES | S21.G00.82, under codes 074 to 080 rather than 060 to 073. One block set in one April declaration carries both filings. A filing component must not assume the block belongs to either. |
| Paying the balance ends the obligation | NO | The payment does. The ALLOCATION does not follow automatically - the employer has a window on SOLTeA in which to direct the funds, and if it does not, a default rule distributes them. Clients regularly discover this after the window closes. |
| ═══ SPECIAL CASES ═══ |  |  |
| A client with establishments inside and outside Alsace-Moselle | YES | Two rates in one legal entity. The rate is establishment-based, so a single company-level rate parameter is wrong. |
| A client that employs apprentices but is above the six-minimum-wage payroll threshold | YES | No exemption. Code 074 is available only below the threshold, and the threshold is a payroll amount that has to be recomputed each year against the current minimum wage. |
| A client with company training centres or that finances new apprenticeship provision | YES | Deductions under code 075, on the authority of Labour Code art. L6241-2. Evidenced outside payroll. |
| A client not liable to the apprenticeship tax at all | YES | Declares code 002 with an MNATA exemption ground. The absence of a declaration is not an exemption, and an employer that simply omits the block has not declared anything. |

## Sheet: `File Structure`

_141 rows x 1 columns._

```text
Solde de la taxe d'apprentissage et assujettissements fiscaux - carried in the April DSN — FILE STRUCTURE AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

═══ FILE FORMAT ═══
Norm            : NEODeS, cahier technique CT2026.1.2 (P26V01,
revision 20251224, release 2026.1.0.9).
Physical form   : a flat text file, one rubrique per record. The norm
states the record layout as  [Sxx.Gyy.zz.aaa,'value']
and gives as its own example:
S21.G00.06.001,'332975200'
There is no XML, no XSD and no fixed-width layout.
A build that assumes XML here is wrong.
Field separator : the comma, hex 2C.
Value delimiter : the apostrophe, hex 27, on both sides of the value.
Record delimiter: CR-LF (hex 0D0A) or LF (hex 0A) alone. Both accepted.
Encoding        : ISO/IEC 8859-1 (E), alphabet Latin-1. Named by the norm
as THE usable character table - not UTF-8.
Extension       : .txt (also accepted inside a .zip for bulk deposit).
Record length   : variable, maximum 256 ASCII characters per record.
The per-value length constraint is the rubrique's own,
from its data type.
(cahier technique CT2026.1.2, section 3, p.77)
Declaration     : nature '01 - DSN Mensuelle'
carried in S20.G00.05.001.

═══ STRUCTURAL HIERARCHY ═══
The file is a strict nesting of blocks. A child block may only appear
inside its parent, and the cardinality shown is the norm's own.

S10.G00.00  Envoi                                   {1,1}
S10.G00.01  Emetteur                              {1,1}
S10.G00.02  Contact Emetteur                      {1,1}
S20.G00.05  Declaration                           {1,*}
S21.G00.06  Entreprise                          {1,1}
S21.G00.11  Etablissement                     {1,*}
S21.G00.30  Individu                        {0,*}
S21.G00.40  Contrat                       {1,*}
S21.G00.50  Versement individu          {1,*}
S21.G00.51  Remuneration              {0,*}
S21.G00.78  Base assujettie           {0,*}
S21.G00.81  Cotisation individuelle {0,*}
S21.G00.22  Bordereau de cotisation due     {0,*}
S21.G00.23  Cotisation agregee            {0,*}
S21.G00.20  Versement organisme             {0,*}
S90.G00.90  Total de l'envoi                        {1,1}

The exact block set carried by THIS declaration nature is the one
listed on the spec sheet; blocks the norm forbids for this nature are
shown there as excluded rather than omitted.

═══ TRANSMISSION AND CHANNEL ═══
Channel  : file_upload - a file generated by the payroll software and
deposited on the portal, or sent machine-to-machine via the
same platform's API.
Portal   : net-entreprises.fr, operated by GIP-MDS.
https://www.net-entreprises.fr/
Deposit  : S10.G00.00.007 = '01 - Net-entreprises'. Value '02 - MSA' is
the agricultural channel and is out of scope for this build.
Test mode: S10.G00.00.005 = '01 - envoi fichier test' routes the file
to the test environment. Conformity is proved with the free
self-check tool before going live; there is no product
certification for France (FR-CCG-001 Module 10.4).
Mandate  : a service provider filing on a client's behalf must be
registered on net-entreprises.fr and hold the client's
mandate. That is a registration, not a software approval.

═══ ONE TAX, TWO RHYTHMS ═══
The apprenticeship tax is 0.68 % of payroll in metropolitan
France and 0.44 % in Alsace-Moselle (FR-CCG-001 Module 6). It is
collected in two completely different ways:

0.59 %  PRINCIPAL   monthly, an ordinary contribution in the
ordinary monthly DSN. Nothing in this
workbook - see FR-DSN-001.

0.09 %  BALANCE     annual. Computed on the CLOSED PRECEDING
year's payroll, declared in the APRIL DSN
of the following year. This workbook.

Getting the split wrong does not fail on deposit. Treating the
whole 0.68 % as monthly over-collects all year and leaves nothing
to declare in April; treating it all as annual under-collects for
eleven months and produces a cash shock in the twelfth.

The engine must hold the preceding year's payroll base as a
FROZEN figure. Recomputing it in April from current data picks up
retroactive corrections posted since the year closed, and the
balance then disagrees with the principal already collected.

═══ WHERE THE APPRENTICESHIP TAX ACTUALLY LIVES ═══
S21.G00.44   Assujettissement fiscal - FIVE levies, fourteen
paired liable / not-liable codes:

001 / 002   apprenticeship tax
003 / 004   supplementary apprenticeship contribution (CSA)
005 / 006   construction-effort levy
007 / 008   vocational-training contribution
009 / 010   PAYROLL TAX      -> return is FR-DGFIP-003
013 / 014   levy funding the professional-transition scheme
015 / 016   payroll-tax base, first and second rate bands

.002  the self-assessed base (auto-liquidation)
.003  reference year
.004  non-liability ground, external referential MNATA

S21.G00.82   Cotisation etablissement, apprenticeship codes:

074  exemption - employer of apprentices with payroll below
six times the minimum wage
075  deductions for company training centres and financing
new apprenticeship provision (Labour Code art. L6241-2)
076  BALANCE PAID IN CASH                        positive
077  reduction - grants in kind to training centres
(art. L6241-4)                              negative
078  reduction - work-study receivables
(art. L6241-4)                              negative
079  supplementary apprenticeship contribution (CSA)
080  exemption from the supplementary contribution

Codes 074 to 080 are ESTABLISHMENT-level: declared once for the
establishment, not per employee, and not in the aggregate
contribution block S21.G00.23.

═══ THE SECOND STEP NOBODY CHASES ═══
Paying the balance does not finish the obligation - it finishes
the PAYROLL part of it.

1.  April DSN          declare and pay the balance    (here)
2.  SOLTeA window      allocate it to named training
institutions                   (FR-CDC-001)

The allocation window ran from 26 May to 21 October in 2026
(FR-CCG-001 Module 10). Where the employer makes no allocation, a
DEFAULT RULE distributes the funds - so inaction has a
consequence, but no consequence that anyone will chase the client
about. The money is already paid; the only thing lost is the
client's say in where it goes.

This is a client decision, not a payroll one. Payroll's duty is
to make sure the client knows the step exists and knows the
window, which is why it is recorded here as well as in
FR-CDC-001.
```

## Sheet: `Population Rules`

_21 rows x 5 columns._

| Rule Category | Field Name | Source System | Population Logic | Edge Cases |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ═══ MANDATORY FIELD RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| The liability position is declared positively, either way | S21.G00.44.001 | The client's tax function, not payroll | The code list is built as seven LIABLE / NOT-LIABLE pairs across five levies. The employer declares its position explicitly in both directions: code 001 for liability to the apprenticeship tax and code 002 for non-liability, and so on for the supplementary contribution, the construction-effort levy, the vocational-training contribution and the payroll tax. Omitting the block does not declare exemption - it declares nothing, and leaves the authority's assumption in place. | The payroll-tax codes (009, 010, 015, 016) are the ones payroll is least equipped to answer, because liability turns on the client's VAT position. Payroll must be given the answer rather than infer it, and the answer must match what is filed on impots.gouv.fr as FR-DGFIP-003. |
| The non-liability ground is a referential value | S21.G00.44.004 | The authority's MNATA table | Where non-liability to the apprenticeship tax is declared, the ground is taken from the external referential MNATA - Motifs de non-assujettissement a la taxe d'apprentissage - which the authority maintains and the norm validates against. It is not free text and it is not a local code list. | Because it is an external referential rather than an enumeration printed in the cahier technique, the current value list must be obtained from the authority at implementation and refreshed. A value that was valid in an earlier year may not be. |
| The reference year, in two places | S21.G00.44.003 and S21.G00.82.003 / .004 | Filing component | The fiscal-liability block carries the year it is subscribed for; the contribution block carries an attachment period. Both must describe the CLOSED PRECEDING calendar year - so the April 2026 declaration carries 2025 and a period of 1 January to 31 December 2025. A component that defaults these to the declared month, which is correct for ordinary monthly contributions, emits April 2026 and declares the wrong year's tax. | This is the same trap as FR-URSSAF-003 and it has the same cause: an annual filing riding a monthly envelope. The two filings share the block, so a component that gets it right for one and wrong for the other produces an April declaration that is internally inconsistent. |
| ═══ CRITICAL VALIDATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| The apprenticeship codes belong to the establishment contribution block, not the aggregate one | S21.G00.82.002 codes 074 to 080 | Filing component | The norm's valorisation note for S21.G00.82.002 lists, for URSSAF, exactly the codes admitted in this block: 060 to 069, 071 to 080 and 091. The apprenticeship codes 074 to 080 are therefore establishment-level values, declared once for the establishment and not per employee, and not in the aggregate contribution block S21.G00.23. | Control CCH-14 additionally FORBIDS these codes where the regulatory reference rubrique S21.G00.82.005 points at a supplementary-cover membership - because that combination would be claiming an apprenticeship position under a private insurance contract reference. |
| Liability and the contribution codes must agree | S21.G00.44.001 against S21.G00.82.002 | Filing component and the client's tax function | Declaring liability to the apprenticeship tax (code 001) and then declaring no balance, or declaring non-liability (code 002) and then a balance under code 076, are both internally inconsistent declarations. The norm does not reconcile them for you - the block is self-assessed - so the reconciliation has to be a build-time control in the filing component. | Because nothing rejects the inconsistency, it survives into production and is found on inspection. Build the cross-check rather than relying on the platform. |
| The exemption is declared, not implied | S21.G00.82.002 codes 074 and 080 | Payroll and the client's tax function | Exemption from the apprenticeship tax for a small employer of apprentices (074) and exemption from the supplementary apprenticeship contribution (080) are POSITIVE declarations with their own codes. An employer that is exempt and files nothing has not claimed the exemption. | Code 074's threshold - payroll below six times the minimum wage - is an amount that moves every year with the minimum wage. A hard-coded threshold silently stops being an exemption the client still qualifies for, or keeps claiming one it no longer does. |
| ═══ AMOUNT FORMAT RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Signed amounts, and which of them are negative | S21.G00.82.001 | Payroll | The contribution value is signed, carries two decimals, and permits zero, per the norm's own pattern in column J. In this filing the sign carries meaning: the balance paid in cash (076) is positive, while the reductions of codes 075, 077 and 078 reduce it and are declared negative. A component that declares every amount positive and expects the authority to net them produces a balance larger than the client owes. | The same rubrique in the same block carries the disabled-worker amounts of FR-URSSAF-003 under different codes and with the same sign convention - deductions negative, contributions positive. |
| Rates are not carried in this file | The 0.68 % and its split | Payroll configuration | The declaration carries amounts and codes, never rates. The 0.68 % total, the 0.59 % / 0.09 % split and the 0.44 % Alsace-Moselle rate live in the payroll configuration and are documented in FR-CCG-001 Modules 3, 5 and 6. They are stated in this workbook's Report Matrix so the two artifacts can be compared, not because the file carries them. | It follows that a rate error is invisible in this filing: the declaration is structurally perfect and the amount is wrong. The control has to be upstream, in the configuration review. |
| ═══ PAYROLL-SPECIFIC POPULATION RULES ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| The two halves of one tax | The 0.59 % and the 0.09 % | Payroll configuration | The principal part is a monthly contribution declared in the ordinary monthly DSN like any other. The balance is annual, computed on the closed preceding year's payroll, and declared here in April. They are the same tax and they are collected on completely different rhythms. The engine must therefore hold the preceding year's payroll base as a closed, frozen figure - not recompute it in April from current data, which would pick up retroactive corrections posted since. | The commonest design error is treating the whole 0.68 % as monthly or the whole 0.68 % as annual. The first over-collects monthly and leaves nothing to declare in April; the second under-collects for eleven months and produces a cash shock in the twelfth. |
| The work-study population | S21.G00.40.008 | HR | The public-policy scheme rubrique distinguishes apprenticeship contracts from professionalisation contracts, and both from every other assisted-contract type. That distinction drives three separate things: the apprenticeship-tax exemption of code 074, the work-study proportion that decides supplementary-contribution liability, and the disabled-worker deductions of FR-URSSAF-003. It must be mapped explicitly from the client's own contract types and signed off. | Source systems commonly label both apprenticeship and professionalisation contracts 'alternance' and distinguish them only in free text. Where that is so, the mapping cannot be derived and has to be built - which is a project task, not a configuration one. |
| Reductions are evidenced outside payroll | S21.G00.82.002 codes 075, 077, 078 | The client's training and finance functions | Deductions for company training centres and for financing new apprenticeship provision (Labour Code art. L6241-2), and reductions for grants in kind to training centres and for work-study receivables (art. L6241-4). None of these amounts originates in payroll; each needs documentary evidence held by whoever incurred it, and each must be passed to the filing with an audit trail. | The norm cites the Labour Code articles inside the code labels themselves, which is unusual and is a signal: these are legally defined categories, not accounting conveniences, and an amount that does not meet the statutory definition is not a reduction however it was booked. |
| After payment: the allocation | Not a rubrique in this file | Client decision, via SOLTeA | Once the balance is declared and paid, the employer may direct it to named training institutions through the Caisse des Depots SOLTeA platform during an annual window - 26 May to 21 October in 2026 per FR-CCG-001 Module 10. Where the employer makes no allocation, a default rule distributes the funds. Payroll's responsibility ends with the declaration, but the client must be told the second step exists. | This is specified as FR-CDC-001. It is the point clients most often miss, because nothing chases them: the money is already paid, and the only consequence of inaction is that somebody else decides where it goes. |
| ═══ CROSS-FIELD VALIDATIONS ═══ |  |  |  |  |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.44.001 code 002 <-> S21.G00.44.004 | The client's tax function | The non-liability ground is conditional on non-liability having been declared: code 002 requires a ground from the MNATA referential, and the ground has no meaning without code 002. Each names the other in its Conditional Reason. | Declaring code 002 without a ground leaves an unexplained exemption on the record; declaring a ground alongside code 001 declares liability and an exemption from it in the same breath. |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.44.001 codes 009 / 010 / 015 / 016 <-> FR-DGFIP-003 | The client's tax function | The payroll-tax liability declared here and the payroll-tax return filed on impots.gouv.fr are two statements of one fact on two portals. Codes 015 and 016 additionally declare the base at the first and second rate bands, which is the same base the 2501-SD return reports. Nothing cross-checks them automatically. | The two systems are owned by different teams in most client organisations - payroll files the DSN, finance files the 2501-SD. A divergence is therefore both easy to create and hard to see, and the build should surface the DSN-side figure to whoever owns the tax return. |
| Bidirectional constraint | S21.G00.82.002 code 076 (balance paid) <-> codes 075 / 077 / 078 (reductions) | Payroll and the client's training function | The reductions exist only against a declared balance. Declaring a reduction with no balance to reduce, or a balance with reductions exceeding it, is arithmetically incoherent even though the self-assessed block accepts it. | Because the block is auto-liquidation, nothing rejects the incoherence. Build the arithmetic check in the filing component or it will not be made anywhere. |

| S21.G00.82.003,'01012025'  S21.G00.82.004,'31122025' | Periode de rattachement | The closed reference year. | Not the declared month. The same trap as FR-URSSAF-003, in the same block, in the same declaration. |
| S21.G00.82.002,'079'  S21.G00.82.001,'2150.00' | Contribution supplementaire a l'apprentissage (CSA) | The supplementary contribution, owed by employers of 250 or more with too few work-study contracts. | ILLUSTRATIVE amount.
